universities.name: Politecnico di Bari
universities.research_summary: Politecnico di Bari's official 2026/27 Computer Engineering MSc is Class LM-32, two years/120 ECTS and taught in English, with curricula in AI and Data Science, Cybersecurity and Cloud, and Cyberphysical Systems. Applicants needed a suitable bachelor's degree, at least 48 ECTS across listed engineering, computer-science, mathematics and related areas, adequate individual preparation and English B2; any curricular integrations had to be completed before entry. The mandatory Esse3 application had multiple 2026/27 windows and had to precede the later enrollment period. Foreign qualifications required document and authenticity checks; applicants needing a visa also used Universitaly. The 2026/27 tuition contribution varied by ISEE and merit/study-progress eligibility: the fee regulation sets no-tax-area criteria and a €2,257.60 contribution cap for high or absent eligible ISEE, plus regional tax and stamp duty. ADISU Puglia aid was an annual competitive call, while the Poliba international award reviewed was restricted to one already-admitted Palestinian student resident in Gaza. No new 2027/28 Computer Engineering first-year call or terms were found; the published February 2027 notice concerns first-level courses only.

source_urls.title: Admissions to first-level degree courses
source_urls.evidence: The official page says 2027/28 admission call instructions for first-level degrees will be published in February 2027.

source_urls.title: Computer Engineering MSc profile
source_urls.evidence: The official profile lists the two-year English-taught Computer Engineering Master's at Bari. Current curricula are Artificial Intelligence and Data Science, Cybersecurity and Cloud, and Cyberphysical Systems. This is prior-cycle profile evidence only.

source_urls.title: Computer Engineering teaching regulations 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: Regulation identifies Class LM-32, 120 ECTS, two-year standard duration, English instruction, and three curricula. Admission requires a suitable bachelor's degree, at least 48 ECTS in listed engineering, computing, mathematics, physics and related areas, adequate preparation and English B2. Admission may require curricular integrations completed before entry; no educational debt is permitted.

source_urls.title: Admission to two-year Master's degrees 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The mandatory prior-to-enrolment Esse3 process accepted one MSc preference per candidate after the bachelor's degree. 2026/27 application windows ran 28 July–15 September, then monthly windows through 10 May 2027. Eligibility checks covered the degree, curricular CFU, individual preparation and required English level. Eligible applicants enrolled 22 September 2026–20 May 2027; admission and enrollment are separate stages.

source_urls.title: General overview for international candidates 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: Foreign-qualification evaluation requires academic records and proof of qualification authenticity. Visa applicants also submit Universitaly pre-enrolment; the 2026/27 page states a national visa-application outer date of 30 November 2026. Computer Engineering is an English-taught MSc, so foreign candidates use the Master's Esse3 assessment route and English evidence; Italian B2 applies to programmes taught in Italian. These are 2026/27 procedures only.

source_urls.title: English B2 assessment for Master's degrees 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: Computer Engineering is included in the 2026/27 Master's language-assessment list. The online English test has 30 questions, lasts 15 minutes and requires at least 21/30; applicants may register up to three working days before published test sessions. This calendar is prior-cycle only.

source_urls.title: Tuition and fee information 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 calculator is ISEE-based and does not include merit reductions, exemptions or penalties. The initial enrollment installment is €136 (€120 regional tax plus €16 stamp duty); the regional contribution is adjusted at T2 according to the eligible ISEE. The annual all-inclusive contribution depends on the fee regulation and student circumstances.

source_urls.title: Student fees and contributions regulations 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The annual all-inclusive contribution is income- and eligibility-dependent; it is zero in the no-tax area at ISEE ≤€26,000 when applicable criteria are satisfied and is capped at €2,257.60 for ISEE ≥€90,000 or absent eligible ISEE, before any late-payment or study-progress penalties. ADISU regional tax and €16 stamp duty are separate; normal contributions are divided across four payments. Merit and aid exemptions have additional conditions.

source_urls.title: ADISU Puglia benefits and scholarship call 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The regional annual benefits call covered eligible students at the Polytechnic University of Bari. Degree-course applications ran 14 July–13 August 2026, noon, online. Awards and services are competitive and subject to the call's economic, merit, enrollment and documentation criteria; no Computer Engineering award is guaranteed.

source_urls.title: PoliBa scholarships and international-student support
source_urls.evidence: The official index lists 2026/27 merit, international-student and other calls. Merit lists shown are for enrolled students and the previous cycle; do not treat them as first-year guarantees. It also records a 2026/27 one-scholarship call for Palestinian students resident in Gaza, restricted to candidates already admitted to an MSc and not compatible with ADISU aid.

source_urls.title: Targeted scholarship for Palestinian students from Gaza 2026/27
source_urls.source_type: Official targeted international scholarship call PDF
source_urls.evidence: The call offered one €22,000 gross award across two years to a Palestinian student resident in Gaza already admitted to a 2026/27 Poliba MSc. It includes €11,000 gross per year, full fee exemption and arrival/psychological support. Deadline was 23 October 2026. Second-year payment requires at least 12 CFU by 31 July 2027 and enrollment in 2027/28; the scholarship is incompatible with ADISU aid and is not a general 2027/28 new-entry award.

universities.name: Politecnico di Milano
universities.research_summary: Politecnico di Milano's 2026/27 official catalogue lists the prior-cycle degree identities for the reviewed legacy candidates. Computer Science and Engineering is a two-year English MSc and its Artificial Intelligence option is a study plan, not a separate catalogue degree. High Performance Computing Engineering is a separate English MSc; its reviewed profile specifies 20 ECTS in computing, 20 in mathematics/statistics and 10 in physics. Biomedical Engineering is separately offered as a BSc in Italian and an MSc in Italian or English. Architecture and Communication Design MScs are listed in Italian or English, while the BSc Progettazione dell'Architettura is also listed in Italian or English. Mechanical Engineering and Design & Engineering profile pages explicitly refer to 2025/26 information and may change in later years. The generic Aerospace Engineering MSc lead was not matched to a standalone catalogue entry: official pages distinguish Aeronautical Engineering MSc, Space Engineering MSc and Aerospace Engineering BSc, so the record remains unresolved. All 17 candidate first-year offers are pending for 2027/28 because the published MSc calendar and scholarship call are university-level and do not name each programme intake; Engineering admissions pages state that the 2027/28 BSc call would follow, while the MSc Engineering deadlines contain a label/date inconsistency. The current tuition page still covers 2026/27; no 2027/28 tuition schedule or 2027/28 program-specific calls, places or admission criteria were confirmed in this batch.

source_urls.title: Deadlines – Admission to Laurea Magistrale with foreign qualification
source_urls.evidence: For September 2027 MSc entry, the page gives general 2027/28 windows of 1 Oct–1 Dec 2026 (early bird), 12–28 Jan 2027 and 1–18 Mar 2027 for EEA and certain non-EEA residents in Italy. Architecture/Design has its own table with a 1 Oct 2026–28 Jan 2027 general call and the same additional March call. A separate Engineering subsection labelled 2026/27 nevertheless describes the September 2027 intake and gives 12 Jan–25 Feb 2027, creating a cycle/date discrepancy that must be resolved by study area. Fees are €50 early bird or €150 standard, and candidates may apply to at most two programmes.

source_urls.title: Engineering BSc enrolment – 2027/28
source_urls.evidence: Publishes the 2027/28 Engineering BSc enrolment calendar: first phase 3 May–10 June 2027 (restricted eligibility and excludes English-taught programmes); preference deadlines for later phases are 17 June, 22 July and 26 August 2027, followed by rankings and enrolment deadlines. The page covers enrolment timing, not the pending cycle-specific Engineering call or total tuition amount. Dates are CEST.

source_urls.title: Documents required by the Admissions Office – English certification
source_urls.evidence: Gives 2027/28 English certificate scores for MSc applicants: TOEFL iBT at least 78 for tests through 20 Jan 2026 and at least 4.5 from 21 Jan 2026; TOEIC at least 785 Listening/Reading and 310 Speaking/Writing; IELTS at least 6; specified Cambridge, Trinity, Pearson and LanguageCert scores. Applicants whose bachelor’s was taught in English for at least three years may be exempt if their university certifies at least 75% of courses were in English.

source_urls.title: Merit Based Call for Applications – A.Y. 2027–2028
source_urls.evidence: Offers 10 Platinum (€10,000 gross), 18 Gold (€8,000 gross), 16 Piacenza Gold (€5,000 gross), 10 Piacenza Bronze (€2,500 gross), and 10 Silver awards (tuition waiver at Cremona, Lecco, Mantova and Piacenza); all include a tuition waiver for the award year. Eligible applicants must be international first-year MSc applicants to English-taught programs for 2027/28 and must have paid the admission application fee during 1 Oct–1 Dec 2026. Scholarship forms are accepted 1 Oct–15 Dec 2026 at noon Italian time. Awards are competitive and subject to admission and acceptance conditions.

It describes the required admission test and non-Italian qualification documentation but does not yet provide the complete 2027/28 call rules, full seat inventory, or all deadlines.

For final-year or already graduated applicants taking a test from 1 Sep 2026 through 3 Jun 2027, the recording deadline is 3 Jun 2027 at 11:59 a.m. A separate 3 Jun deadline applies to the specified 2025/26 penultimate-year cohort that missed the prior recording deadline.

universities.name: Politecnico di Torino
universities.research_summary: Politecnico di Torino's official 2026/27 Master's catalogue and course profiles were checked against all eight legacy candidates. Computer Engineering is Italian and English; Aerospace Engineering is Italian; Architecture Construction City is Italian and English; and the current title for the legacy ICT for Smart Societies row is ICT Engineering for Smart Societies (English). The other matched candidates are English-taught. Profiles identify a two-year, 120-ECTS MSc structure, course codes and campuses; the 2026/27 foreign-applicant annex supplies recommended backgrounds and IELTS 5.5 minima for the English routes. Those backgrounds are explicitly recommendations, not binding minimum entry conditions. The foreign-admissions page gives a first-cycle qualification, suitable academic performance, course-specific curricular review, and B2 language rules. Its 2026/27 dates and €50 application fee are retained as historical evidence only. The current fee page links 2026/27 tuition regulations and EDISU aid; no 2027/28 fee schedule or scholarship award was confirmed. An additional interdisciplinary English MSc, Digital Skills for Sustainable Societal Transitions, was identified because the official 2026/27 admissions annex lists Information Technology and Computer Sciences among its recommended backgrounds; it is not a conventional Computer Science degree. The checked named course profiles are for 2026/27, so all nine course-level 2027/28 first-year offers and current admission, fee and scholarship terms remain unverified. No official acceptance-rate denominator and admitted count were found.

source_urls.title: HySET applications open for the 2027–2029 edition
source_urls.evidence: Official announcement says the fifth HySET edition covers academic years 2027–2029 and opened 1 October 2026; the application deadline is 15 November 2026. HySET is jointly coordinated by Politecnico di Torino and Politecnico di Milano with international consortium partners.

source_urls.title: HySET admission requirements
source_urls.evidence: Requires a relevant bachelor’s degree of at least 180 ECTS in listed engineering/science fields; minimum English evidence is TOEFL iBT 90 with at least 21 in each section, IELTS 6.5 overall with at least 6.0 each section, or Cambridge 160 (higher threshold for a TU/e destination). Selection is scored on academic achievements, background relevance, references/video, and experience. The current page states a 2027–29 call is open.

source_urls.title: HySET programme structure and awarded degrees
source_urls.evidence: Describes a 120-ECTS four-semester master’s, with first-year entry allocated between Politecnico di Torino and Politecnico di Milano and second-year mobility to a consortium partner. Depending on the partner route, students earn two master’s degrees; the programme focuses on the hydrogen value chain.

source_urls.title: HySET frequently asked questions – language of instruction
source_urls.evidence: States that the entire HySET programme is taught in English.

source_urls.title: HySET continuation beyond 2026 – funding and admissions
source_urls.evidence: States that funding for the 2027 cohort had not yet been secured and future scholarships depend on a successful external funding award; scholarship availability is not guaranteed. The separate self-funded page states annual fees of €4,500 for European students and €9,000 for non-European students.

source_urls.title: HySET self-funded students – tuition fees
source_urls.evidence: Lists self-funded tuition as €4,500 per year (€9,000 total) for European students and €9,000 per year (€18,000 total) for non-European students; living costs and travel between partner universities are excluded. Payment details/deadlines are to be provided later.

source_urls.title: Admissions and enrolment – Master's degree programmes

source_urls.title: Applicants with a non-Italian qualification – Master's degree programmes
source_urls.evidence: For the 2026/27 cycle, applicants need a foreign first-cycle degree giving access to second-cycle study, suitable academic performance, programme-specific curricular requirements and language evidence. English-taught programmes require English B2; Italian or mixed Italian/English programmes require English B2 and Italian B2. Applicants can select up to two programmes. The page gives 2026/27 calls (including a third call restricted to EU and non-EU residents in Italy) and a €50 application fee; these are historical and do not set 2027/28 dates or fees.

source_urls.title: 2026/27 entry requirements for Master's programmes

It lists IELTS 5.5 for the English routes of Automotive Engineering, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity Engineering, Data Science and Engineering, ICT Engineering for Smart Societies, Quantum Engineering and Architecture Construction City. Recommended backgrounds vary by course; these are recommendations, not stated as automatic eligibility rules. Digital Skills lists Information Technology and Computer Sciences among its recommended backgrounds. The annex is not a 2027/28 requirements document.

source_urls.title: Tuition fees and EDISU scholarships

It links EDISU Piemonte benefits for 2026/27. No 2027/28 fee regulation or course-specific scholarship amount is recorded by this source.

universities.name: Università degli Studi Roma Tre
universities.research_summary: Roma Tre's legacy Engineering MSc remains an unresolved course identity: the official 2026/27 catalogue lists multiple distinct Engineering degrees, including English Sustainable Coastal and Ocean Engineering and Biomedical Engineering. The generic candidate is preserved without a speculative match. GOMP handles university procedures and Universitaly handles visa pre-enrollment. The national circular covers 2027/28 and sets an outer visa-application deadline of 31 October 2027, subject to earlier university dates; Roma Tre's displayed 15 September 2026 deadline belongs to 2026/27. Tuition remains income/course-dependent, with prior-cycle fixed charges of 140 euros regional tax plus 16 euros stamp duty. DiSCo's reviewed competition is 2026/27; closed UNICORE awards support the 2026/27 refugee cohort through 2027/28 under renewal conditions. Current foreign-qualification contact is international.admissions@uniroma3.it. No 2027/28 first-year course-specific intake, annual tuition schedule or new-entrant scholarship call was identified.

source_urls.title: International Students Admission
source_urls.evidence: Describes international admission steps for first- and second-cycle courses; a reviewed guide is for 2026/27, so no 2027/28 dates are inferred.

source_urls.evidence: Department page dated 1 September 2026 describes Sustainable Coastal and Ocean Engineering and Aerospace Engineering MSc courses as offered in English; central Aerospace profile instead says Italian/English.

source_urls.title: International Students – current central guidance
source_urls.evidence: Current page links 2026/27 course calls and a national circular valid for 2026/27 and 2027/28. Its own Universitaly deadline is explicitly 15 September 2026; university pre-enrollment approval does not guarantee a consular visa.

source_urls.title: How to apply – students with foreign qualifications 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: Prior-cycle guide requires at least 12 school years for bachelor entry and a relevant first-cycle degree for MSc entry. GOMP assessment uses degree/transcript and detailed syllabi, translation/authenticity evidence as applicable; visa applicants also use Universitaly, then original-document verification. The introduction retains an outdated 2025/26 national-reference line.
