source_urls.evidence: Engineering sections require a suitable first-cycle/equivalent degree, course-regulation curricular requirements and prior-career assessment. B2 English is stated for Sustainable Coastal/Ocean, Aerospace and Biomedical. The annual call distinguishes a 70-euro Italian language test and a 60-euro supplementary assessment surcharge; neither establishes a generic 2027/28 application fee.

source_urls.title: National international-student procedures 2026/27 and 2027/28
source_urls.evidence: Circular has explicit biennial validity. For degree courses the 2027/28 national visa-application outer deadline is 31 October 2027; universities may set earlier dates. Visa pre-enrollment uses Universitaly. Non-Italian courses require certification of their teaching language rather than an Italian test; visa-stage non-native language evidence must cover four skills at least at B2. This does not confirm any Roma Tre course intake.

source_urls.title: Tasse e contributi universitari
source_urls.evidence: Page states 2026/27 regional tax of 140 euros plus 16-euro stamp duty, with a separate income/course-dependent annual university contribution. One to four installments depend on the fee band; first-year payment deadlines come from the admission call. The fixed 156 euros is not normal total tuition.

source_urls.title: Regolamento Tasse – DR 70/2026
source_urls.evidence: Current regulation applies from 2025/26 and was updated in January 2026. Contribution and exemptions depend on ISEE, course and career conditions; the foreign-income route uses ISEE Parificato through the agreed CAF. Its general continuing rules are not a dedicated 2027/28 annual fee schedule.

source_urls.title: Presentazione ISEE
source_urls.evidence: 2026/27 first-year students have 60 days from enrollment to present ISEE. Missing ISEE normally means the highest contribution bracket. Eligible foreign-income/nonresident households use the Personal CAF/CAF CISL process; even DiSCo winners with foreign income must submit the required declaration.

source_urls.title: DiSCo – 2026/27 right-to-study competition announcement
source_urls.evidence: Regional provider's 10 June 2026 announcement covers students at Lazio institutions and scholarships, accommodation, meals and other benefits. Application first phase ran 10 June–22 July 2026 at noon; enrollment could be completed by 10 February 2027. This is the prior-cycle competition, not a 2027/28 award call.

source_urls.title: DiSCo – Bando Diritto allo Studio 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: Official indexed call extract states scholarship ISEE/ISEEUP ceiling 28,339.88 euros and ISPE/ISPEUP ceiling 61,608.48 euros; exceeding either excludes the applicant. Full PDF retrieval returned HTTP 403 in this review, so detailed awards and documentation were not exhaustively verified.

source_urls.title: International Students Office – contact details
source_urls.evidence: Current International Students Office supports foreign-qualification pre-enrollment, admission and enrollment. Relevant email is international.admissions@uniroma3.it; address Via Ostiense 133, Tower B, 00154 Rome. This supersedes the older orientation page's foreign-qualification email/address for current contact purposes.

source_urls.title: UNICORE 8.0 – two refugee scholarships for 2026/27 entrants
source_urls.evidence: Closed refugee-only call admitted two 2026/27 MSc entrants; support extends to 2027/28 subject to renewal. Applications ran 2 March–17 April 2026 noon UTC+2. Benefits include fee exemption, housing and meals. Renewal needs 25 CFU by 10 August 2027. This is not a new 2027/28 entrant competition.

universities.name: Sapienza Università di Roma
universities.research_summary: Sapienza's English admissions page and 2026/27 MoveIN requirements PDF list Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence and Robotics, Cybersecurity, Data Science, Applied Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence, and Sustainable Building Engineering among the program candidates. The PDF supplies historical course requirements and B2 English evidence; for example, Computer Science required a relevant bachelor’s degree and specified curricular credits, while Data Science used a preparation review, online test and committee interview. The 2026/27 MoveIN cycle required separate pre-selection, with 2026 deadlines, and visa applicants also had Universitaly and foreign-qualification checks. Other official 2026/27 catalogue matches include Aeronautical Engineering LM-20 (Italian/English), Aerospace Engineering L-9 (Italian), Political Science and International Relations L-36 (Italian), Psychology and Health L-24 (Italian), and multiple Medicine and Surgery LM-41 campus variants; the legacy Medicine lead does not identify a campus, so it remains ambiguous. The same-name Economia e finanza entry is an L-33 bachelor’s course in 2026/27, whereas Finance and Insurance is a distinct LM-16 Master’s; the latter is tracked separately. The English Engineering in Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence LM-32 course is also kept separate from the older archived Ingegneria Informatica lead. 2026/27 fee tables, Wanted the Best scholarship eligibility and DiSCo Lazio aid are stored as prior-cycle context. No reviewed official page confirms a 2027/28 first-year intake, deadlines, fees or awards for these candidates.

source_urls.title: International Students Office
source_urls.evidence: The cycle-specific information reviewed is for 2026/27; the 2027/28 program calls remain outstanding.

source_urls.title: Programmes in English and 2026/27 pre-selection
source_urls.evidence: English-taught degree applicants used MoveIN pre-selection. The 2026/27 cycle opened 22 December 2025; the non-EU visa-applicant deadline was 15 May 2026, the EU/equivalent deadline was 31 July 2026, and Universitaly pre-enrolment was due 30 June 2026. A candidate could submit up to two applications. Pre-selection was only one step and did not guarantee final admission. No 2027/28 first-year schedule is stated on the reviewed page.

source_urls.title: English-program academic and language requirements 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The official PDF lists 2026/27 English bachelor’s and master’s programs and gives program-specific prior-cycle entry requirements. It lists Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence and Robotics, Cybersecurity, Data Science, Applied Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence, and Sustainable Building Engineering among the tracker’s matches. Requirements and scores belong to 2026/27 only.

source_urls.title: International Student Office admissions procedures 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 procedure distinguishes EU/equivalent candidates from non-EU applicants residing abroad. English-course applicants requiring a study visa needed the MoveIN pre-acceptance letter and Universitaly pre-enrolment by 30 June 2026; final admission still depended on the individual course call, qualification verification, visa, and completed enrollment. Foreign qualifications were reviewed for authenticity and comparability. Italian-taught programs required certified Italian B2 for non-EU applicants abroad who needed a visa.

source_urls.title: Engineering in Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence course regulations 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The archived 2026/27 catalogue identifies the two-year, 120-ECTS LM-32 MSc, taught exclusively in English. Admission required a suitable bachelor’s degree, at least 60 recognized ECTS across defined scientific and engineering areas (including at least 24 basic-science and 36 engineering/computing credits, with specified sub-minima), and English B2; a committee assessed preparation and could interview applicants.

source_urls.title: Aeronautical Engineering course profile 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 catalogue identifies Ingegneria aeronautica - Aeronautical engineering as a two-year LM-20 Master’s degree in Rome with Italian and English listed as languages of instruction. This bilingual course is not the separate Space and Astronautical Engineering program.

source_urls.title: Medicine and Surgery course catalogue entries 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 catalogue lists several single-cycle LM-41 Medicine and Surgery courses at separate campuses. It lists one distinct English-taught course, Medicine and Surgery F, as a six-year program. The legacy candidate does not identify its campus or track, so the English and Italian variants are not merged.

source_urls.title: Aerospace Engineering bachelor’s course profile 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 catalogue identifies Ingegneria Aerospaziale as a three-year L-9 bachelor’s degree in Rome, taught in Italian, with an entry test.

source_urls.title: Political Science and International Relations bachelor’s profile 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 catalogue identifies Scienze politiche e relazioni internazionali as a three-year L-36 bachelor’s degree in Rome, taught in Italian. Its entry route is a test to verify knowledge.

source_urls.title: Psychology and Health bachelor’s profile 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 catalogue identifies Psicologia e Salute as a three-year L-24 bachelor’s degree in Rome, taught in Italian and with an admission test.

source_urls.title: Economics and Finance bachelor’s listing 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The same-name 2026/27 course is Economia e finanza, an L-33 three-year bachelor’s program, not the MSc classification in the previous tracker. The catalogue lists Italian and English, but this does not establish that the entire course is English-taught. The match to the old MSc lead is unresolved.

source_urls.title: Finance and Insurance Master’s profile 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The separate 2026/27 Finance and Insurance program is a two-year LM-16 Master’s degree in Rome. The catalogue lists Italian and English curricula/language, so it is not represented as entirely English-taught. It is tracked separately from the same-name Economia e finanza L-33 bachelor’s course.

source_urls.title: Ingegneria Informatica historical course archive
source_urls.evidence: The archived official document identifies the earlier Ingegneria Informatica as an LM-32 two-year Master’s degree. This is older than the immediate prior cycle and does not establish a 2026/27 or 2027/28 offer. The 2026/27 English Engineering in Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence course is tracked separately pending proof of course succession.

source_urls.title: Tuition, payment and foreign-income guidance 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 tuition page describes ISEE-based reductions, three installments of 30%, 35% and 35%, the ordinary fee framework and foreign-income rules. These are annual rules and the amount depends on course area and individual circumstances.

source_urls.title: Standard registration-fee amounts for 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The listed standard total for the Information Engineering, Computer Science and Statistics faculty group is €2,924 in three installments. For students declaring foreign income, the page lists fixed contribution bands of €300, €700 or €1,500 by country group. These categories and amounts should not be combined into an individual quote without checking the student’s course, residence, income and exemptions.

source_urls.title: MoveIN pre-selection application fee 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The official admissions information states a €30 fee for each pre-selection application, up to two applications per candidate and intake, with no waiver. The general International Student Office separately describes a €10 course requirement-assessment payment for applicable Master’s routes; these are different processes.

source_urls.title: Wanted the Best merit scholarship call 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 call offered 85 two-year awards of €3,000 gross per year to students enrolling in a Sapienza Master’s after earning their first degree at another Italian university with a grade from 105/110 to 110/110 cum laude. Deadline: 30 October 2026. It is not a general award for applicants whose prior degree is from abroad.

source_urls.title: DiSCo Lazio Right to Education call 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The regional competitive call covered students at Lazio universities, including Sapienza, and offered scholarships, housing, mobility grants and other benefits subject to the annual economic and merit rules. The application deadline was extended to 23 July 2026 at 20:00; corrections in the second phase closed 11 August. It is prior-cycle regional aid, not a guaranteed Sapienza or program award.

universities.name: Università degli Studi di Roma Tor Vergata
universities.research_summary: The Mechatronics Engineering MSc has a detailed official 2027/28 call; the historic Computer Science row remains unverified.

source_urls.title: Admission A.Y. 2027-28 – Mechatronics Engineering
source_urls.evidence: MSc Mechatronics Engineering, two years/120 credits, taught in English; lists non-EU visa applicant windows 9–27 Nov 2026, 11–25 Jan 2027, 8–22 Feb 2027 and resident window 5 Jul–6 Sep 2027; €30 application fee, 60 non-EU-abroad seats plus 4 Marco Polo places, B2 English, curricular requirements and document list.

source_urls.title: Aims and scopes – Mechatronics Engineering
source_urls.evidence: States the program is taught entirely in English; the current cycle-specific admission page separately confirms 2027/28 availability.

universities.name: Università Ca' Foscari Venezia
universities.research_summary: The official international qualification page says 2027/28 applications open in December 2026; exact periods and program calls remain pending. The 2026/27 catalogue was checked against all Ca' Foscari tracker leads: Hospitality Innovation and e-Tourism is a BSc, and no separate Digital Management MSc is listed. Buddhism and Asian Religions is separately confirmed for 2027/28. The university has announced 2027/28 Honours scholarships, while tuition and regional-aid details remain prior-cycle only.

source_urls.title: Preliminary evaluation of international qualifications
source_urls.evidence: States that applications for international qualifications seeking 2027/28 bachelor’s or master’s admission start in December 2026; exact calls and dates are to be published later.

source_urls.title: Buddhism and Asian Religions – programme and 2027/28 admission
source_urls.evidence: States that the MSc activates in 2027/28; level MSc, LM-64, Venice, English, two years/120 credits and open admission. The admission page says detailed 2027/28 procedures and deadlines will be updated in March 2027; the enrolment page requires B2 English and adequate preparation.

source_urls.title: Financial aid for high-achieving international students
source_urls.evidence: For 2027/28 lists 8 bachelor scholarships of €10,000/year for three years and 20 master’s scholarships of €10,000/year for two years. Ranking factors include CGPA at least 85%, motivational video, reference letters and language evidence; the complete call with exact deadlines is expected in late fall. The page lists International Office contact +39 041 234 7575 and prospective.students@unive.it.

source_urls.title: International programmes – English-taught degree list (2026/27)
source_urls.evidence: The official page groups English-taught bachelor's and master's programmes for 2026/27, including Computer Science - Data Science, Computer Science and Information Technology, Data Analytics for Business and Society, Economics, Finance and Sustainability, International Management, Comparative International Relations, Digital Management, Economics and Business, Hospitality Innovation and e-Tourism, and Philosophy, International and Economic Studies. This is the latest displayed course list, not a 2027/28 new-entry catalogue.

source_urls.title: Bachelor's and Master's degrees – course catalogue (2026/27)
source_urls.evidence: The official catalogue labels its course lists a.y. 2026/27 and includes course codes and languages. It lists Computer Science and Information Technology (CM90) as an English MSc and Informatica (CTR3) as a BSc with Italian and English language entries; Digital Management appears in the bachelor's list, not as a separate master's degree. Hospitality Innovation and e-Tourism (CTR9) appears in the bachelor's list. This does not confirm first-year availability for 2027/28.

source_urls.title: Annual tuition fees – international degree programmes (2026/27 entry guide)
source_urls.evidence: For 2026/27 entry, the guide lists annual fees by group: Italy/EU €2,352 BSc and €2,599 MSc; non-EU OECD €2,100 and €2,300; developing-country group €700 at both levels; all other countries €1,300 at both levels. It lists exceptions including Digital Management (€8,811) and Hospitality Innovation and e-Tourism (€7,025). These are prior-cycle guide figures, may interact with fee-reduction rules, and are not 2027/28 amounts.

source_urls.title: Regional right-to-study scholarship (2026/27)
source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 page describes the Veneto regional grant administered by Ca' Foscari, a combination of cash and services, income eligibility below ISEE €26,306.25 and ISPE €43,125.94, and a general application deadline of 30 September 2026 at 12:30. The related ISEE-information page gives a later 18 December 2026 ISEE-equivalent submission deadline for first-year master's students. These are prior-cycle conditions; no 2027/28 regional call is confirmed here.

source_urls.title: Welcome Unit – international degree-seeker contact
source_urls.evidence: Identifies welcome@unive.it as the contact for degree-seeking and prospective international students and evaluation of international qualifications; the page provides appointment-based support in Italian and English.

source_urls.title: Digital Management – Bachelor's programme profile
source_urls.evidence: The profile identifies Digital Management as a three-year English BSc, L-18 R, 180 ECTS, Roncade, with limited admission. The page is the current programme profile and does not confirm a 2027/28 first-year intake.

source_urls.title: Economics and Business – Bachelor's programme profile
source_urls.evidence: The profile identifies Economics and Business as a three-year English BSc, L-33 R, 180 ECTS, Venice, with limited admission. The page does not confirm a 2027/28 first-year intake.

source_urls.title: Data Analytics for Business and Society – Master's programme profile
source_urls.evidence: The profile identifies a two-year English MSc, LM-91 R, 120 ECTS, Venice, open admission and a double/joint-degree option. It does not confirm a 2027/28 first-year intake.

source_urls.title: Economics, Finance and Sustainability – Master's programme profile
source_urls.evidence: The profile identifies a two-year English MSc, LM-56 R, 120 ECTS, Venice, open admission and a double/joint-degree option. It does not confirm a 2027/28 first-year intake.

source_urls.title: International Management – Master's programme profile
source_urls.evidence: The profile identifies a two-year English MSc, LM-77 R, 120 ECTS, Venice, limited admission and a double/joint-degree option. It does not confirm a 2027/28 first-year intake.

source_urls.title: Comparative International Relations – Master's programme profile
source_urls.evidence: The profile identifies a two-year MSc, LM-52 R, 120 ECTS, Venice, open admission, a double/joint-degree option and Italian/English teaching. The previous tracker’s English-only label is incomplete. It does not confirm a 2027/28 first-year intake.

source_urls.title: Computer Science – Bachelor's programme profile
source_urls.evidence: The profile identifies a three-year BSc, L-31 R, 180 ECTS, Mestre, open admission, with Italian/English language entries and three curricula; only the Data Science curriculum is taught in English. It does not confirm a 2027/28 first-year intake.

source_urls.title: Computer Science and Information Technology – Master's programme profile
source_urls.evidence: The profile identifies a two-year English MSc, LM-18, 120 ECTS, Mestre and open admission. It does not confirm a 2027/28 first-year intake.

source_urls.title: Hospitality Innovation and e-Tourism – Bachelor's programme profile
source_urls.evidence: The profile identifies Hospitality Innovation and e-Tourism as a three-year English BSc, L-15 R, 180 ECTS, Venice/Mestre, limited admission. The prior tracker classified it as an MSc; the latest official profile lists the BSc. It does not confirm a 2027/28 first-year intake.

source_urls.title: Philosophy, International and Economic Studies – Bachelor's programme profile
source_urls.evidence: The profile identifies a three-year English BSc, L-5 R, 180 ECTS, Venice and limited admission. It does not confirm a 2027/28 first-year intake.

source_urls.title: Digital Management – 2026/27 admission and enrolment
source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 procedure is limited admission with TOLC-E, spring and summer rounds, mathematics assessment, B2 English, and international-qualification procedures. These requirements and rounds are prior-cycle evidence, not 2027/28 terms.

source_urls.title: Economics and Business – 2026/27 admission and enrolment
source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 procedure is limited admission with TOLC-E, spring and summer rounds, mathematics assessment, mandatory B2 English by enrolment, and international-qualification procedures. These requirements and rounds are prior-cycle evidence, not 2027/28 terms.

source_urls.title: Data Analytics for Business and Society – 2026/27 admission and enrolment
source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 page describes open admission, a three-year bachelor's qualification, at least 60 CFU in relevant business/economics/statistical-mathematics subjects (including minimum 12 CFU in economics/business and 12 in statistical mathematics), CV assessment and potential interview, and B2 English. These are prior-cycle requirements.

source_urls.title: Computer Science – 2026/27 admission and enrolment
source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 page says Computer Science has open admission and only the Data Science curriculum is taught in English. TOLC-I is recommended; scores below 20/40 or no test lead to a mathematics-logic OFA, and the English curriculum requires B2. These are prior-cycle terms.

source_urls.title: Computer Science and Information Technology – 2026/27 admission and enrolment
source_urls.evidence: The page gives prior-cycle MSc conditions: at least 48 CFU in listed computer-science, mathematics, physics and statistics subject areas; personal preparation assessed through the CV and potentially an interview, with stated degree/85-of-110 exemption criteria; and B2 English. These are not confirmed for 2027/28.

universities.name: Università degli Studi di Milano-Bicocca
universities.research_summary: The international admissions page confirms country-specific entry requirements will apply in 2027/28. Six prior tracker leads are matched to 2026/27 course material; current-cycle first-year offers, course calls, fees and scholarships remain unconfirmed.

source_urls.title: Access for students with an international qualification
source_urls.evidence: For 2027/28, the university says foreign-qualification entry requirements will vary depending on the country where the qualification was obtained and directs applicants to apply.unimib.it and country-specific guidance. Its current instructions require foreign-qualification applicants to apply through that platform. This page does not give degree-program application dates or confirm the six candidate programs for 2027/28.

source_urls.title: International Courses – programmes entirely taught in English
source_urls.evidence: Lists Artificial Intelligence, Artificial Intelligence for Science and Technology, Astrophysics and Space Physics, Data Science, Human-Centered Artificial Intelligence and International Economics among the University's programmes entirely taught in English. The page is not a 2027/28 first-year call.

source_urls.title: Sciences – Master's degree programmes
source_urls.evidence: The official catalogue lists Artificial Intelligence for Science and Technology, Astrophysics and Space Physics, and Data Science as Master's degrees taught in English with open access subject to entry-requirement examination. It does not publish a 2027/28 intake notice.

source_urls.title: Artificial Intelligence – inter-university Bachelor's degree
source_urls.evidence: The Bachelor's in Artificial Intelligence is an English-taught inter-university L-31 degree with administrative headquarters at Pavia and classes across Pavia, Milano Statale and Milano-Bicocca. The profile states three years, limited access and that admission is managed by the University of Pavia.

source_urls.title: Artificial Intelligence – admission call 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The University of Pavia administers the 2026/27 call for the English L-31 Bachelor's in Artificial Intelligence, offered with Milano-Bicocca and Milano Statale. The call lists 130 EU/equivalent or Italy-resident places, 45 non-EU-abroad places and 5 Marco Polo places; selection uses an admission test (CEnT-S or eligible prior English TOLC-I for specified categories, SAT for non-EU applicants abroad). These are prior-cycle quotas and rules.

source_urls.title: Artificial Intelligence – 2026/27 admission FAQ
source_urls.evidence: Pavia's FAQ gives 2026/27 registration windows of 9–25 June and 5–22 October 2026, with the second ranking on 10 November and enrollment through 16 November. It lists the relevant CEnT-S, English TOLC-I and SAT score thresholds by applicant category. These are prior-cycle dates and thresholds only.

source_urls.title: Artificial Intelligence for Science and Technology – Master's profile
source_urls.evidence: The current official title is Artificial Intelligence for Science and Technology, LM-91, two years, English, based jointly across Milano and Pavia and administered by Milano-Bicocca. The course profile links to its 2026/27 call for application.

source_urls.title: Artificial Intelligence for Science and Technology – admission procedure 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 procedure requires a Bachelor's degree or equivalent, at least 30 CFU overall in specified computer-science, mathematics, statistics or physics areas, B2 English, and a personal-preparation interview. Italian-qualification applications ran 2 March–1 September 2026 with a €30 fee; foreign-qualification applicants used DreamApply/apply.unimib. These are prior-cycle rules and dates.

source_urls.title: Astrophysics and Space Physics – Master's profile
source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 profile identifies a two-year, English-taught LM-58 Master's in Milan with open access subject to entry-requirement examination and links the 2026/27 call.

source_urls.title: Astrophysics and Space Physics – admission procedure 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 call requires a suitable Bachelor's degree. An L-30 degree satisfies curricular entry; other degree classes require at least 18 CFU in mathematics and 18 CFU in physics. Personal preparation is assessed by interview; Physics/Astrophysics/Astronomy L-30 graduates with at least 90/110 are exempt. B2 English is required. Italian-qualification applications ran 13 April–19 June and 22 June–11 September 2026 with a €30 fee; foreign-qualification applicants use apply.unimib.it. These are prior-cycle rules and dates.

source_urls.title: Data Science – Master's profile
source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 profile identifies a two-year, 120-ECTS English-taught LM Data Master's in Milan with open access subject to entry-requirement examination; it links the 2026/27 application procedure.

source_urls.title: Data Science – admission procedure 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 call requires a Bachelor's degree, at least 30 CFU overall across informatics, computer engineering, statistics, mathematics and physics, B2 English and a personal-preparation interview. Italian-qualification applications ran 1 April–27 May and 29 May–1 September 2026 with a €30 fee. Foreign-qualification applicants applied through apply.unimib.it. These are prior-cycle rules and dates.

source_urls.title: International Economics – Master's profile
source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 profile identifies a two-year, English-taught LM-56 R Master's in Milan with open access subject to entry-requirement examination and links its current-year admission calls.

source_urls.title: International Economics – admission procedure 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 call requires a Bachelor's qualification and B2 English. The standard-degree route specifies L-18/L-33 or legacy L-17/L-28 with at least 110/110; candidates outside that route may be assessed on economics/business, quantitative methods and legal principles, with interview possible. Foreign-qualification candidates use DreamApply. Applications ran 1 April–7 September 2026; these are prior-cycle criteria and dates. No application fee was stated in the reviewed call.

source_urls.title: Human-Centered Artificial Intelligence – inter-university Master's profile
source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 profile identifies a two-year, English-taught LM-55 inter-university Master's across Milano and Pavia, jointly organized by Milano-Bicocca, Pavia and Milano Statale. The University of Milan is the administrative headquarters and manages admission.

source_urls.title: Human-Centered Artificial Intelligence – application AY 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The University of Milan managed 2026/27 HCAI admission. Applications ran 22 January–30 October 2026 and enrolment 5 May 2026–15 January 2027; non-EU visa applicants had to apply by 30 April 2026. The next-cycle dates are not established by this page.

source_urls.title: Bicocca International Scholarship Programme – call AY 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 call reserves eligibility for international students residing abroad with foreign qualifications. It lists Data Science, International Economics, Artificial Intelligence for Science and Technology, Astrophysics and Space Physics, and Human-Centered Artificial Intelligence among participating Master's courses. It assigns five competitive awards per listed course, each worth €10,000 gross per academic year plus a tuition-fee exemption; administrative and regional fees remain payable. The call's separate undergraduate entry uses the wording 'Artificial Science (LT)', so the BSc Artificial Intelligence lead is not matched to that award here.

source_urls.title: Student contribution fees AY 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: For 2026/27, the University expanded its ISEE no-tax area to €30,000 subject to merit criteria. The general student contribution is variable by ISEE and course area; non-Italian citizens with foreign entry qualifications and foreign residence follow a fixed country-of-residence and course-area tariff. No 2027/28 fee schedule was identified.

source_urls.title: Student contribution and fees FAQ 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 FAQ lists a €146 first installment (regional-tax advance plus stamp), later variable charges, ISEE-based no-tax eligibility up to €30,000 subject to merit, and an ISEE submission deadline of 13 November 2026. It is prior-cycle general guidance, not an individual international student's fee quote.

source_urls.title: Benefits for the right to university education – call AY 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The University announced the 2026/27 DSU call for scholarships and student benefits; applications opened 7 July 2026 through the Online Help Desk, with deadlines varying by benefit in the call. Annual eligibility, award amounts and deadlines must be rechecked for 2027/28.

source_urls.title: Contacts – International degree-seeking students
source_urls.evidence: The International Admissions and Welcome Office manages international admission and enrollment procedures and directs applicants holding foreign qualifications to apply.unimib.it. Contact information is general and does not establish a 2027/28 course deadline.

universities.name: Università Politecnica delle Marche
universities.research_summary: Official sources list the Data Science for Finance and Economics curriculum under the broader English MSc for 2026/27. No 2027/28 first-year listing or call was identified; admissions dates, fees and awards remain unconfirmed for the new cycle.

source_urls.title: International admissions – AY 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The page explicitly limits the pre-evaluation procedure to AY 2026/27, lists up to two program applications with a €10 fee per application, and gives category-specific calls from December 2025 through November 2026. Non-EU applicants requiring visas proceed through Universitaly after positive evaluation; the visa pre-enrolment deadline shown is 30 November 2026. These procedures and dates are prior-cycle evidence only.

source_urls.title: Data Science for Economics, Business and Finance – UnivPM Orienta
source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 profile identifies Data Science for Finance and Economics as a curriculum within Data Science for Economics, Business and Finance (LM-DATA), fully taught in English, open access with knowledge assessment, based in Ancona. The profile describes on-site lectures; a separate annual faculty notice specifies a delivery exception for this curriculum in 2026/27. This is not a 2027/28 new-entry confirmation.

source_urls.title: Data Science for Economics, Business and Finance – 2026/27 catalogue
source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 Faculty catalogue lists the Data Science for Economics, Business and Finance Master's with LM-56 R, LM-91 R and LM-DATA classifications, and open access. The Finance and Economics name is a curriculum of this wider MSc, not a separately listed degree.

source_urls.title: Entry requirements for Master's degree courses – Faculty of Economics
source_urls.evidence: The AY 2026/27 page lists the Data Science for Economics and Enterprises degree, including the Data Science for Finance and Economics curriculum, and states that curricular requirements and adequacy of preparation are verified for Master's applicants. Detailed curriculum and credit criteria are retained from the official prior-year regulation as historical context.

source_urls.title: Data Science for Economics, Business and Finance – teaching regulations 2025/26
source_urls.evidence: The prior-year regulation specifies a suitable first-cycle qualification, named Italian degree-class routes or curricular credits, individual preparation assessment and B2 English. It lists a threshold of 12 CFU in ICT/mathematical-statistical subjects and 12 CFU in economics/statistics/business-related sectors for applicants following the curricular-credit route. Its grade/interview provisions are specific to the 2025/26 regulation and must not be carried forward as current rules.

source_urls.title: Language requirements for programs taught in English
source_urls.evidence: The international office states that students entering English-taught programs must demonstrate English at CEFR B2 through recognized certification or accepted documentation. Program-specific acceptable evidence and exemptions must be checked in the annual course procedure.

source_urls.title: Teaching activity methods AY 2026/27 – Faculty of Economics
source_urls.evidence: The Faculty's 2026/27 notice says the Data Science for Finance and Economics curriculum's lessons are provided by streaming or asynchronously as recorded lectures; examinations and graduation sessions remain in person. This annual exception is scoped to 2026/27 and differs from the generic course profile's on-site label.

source_urls.title: Tuition and fees AY 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The first 2026/27 installment is €156 (€140 regional tax and €16 stamp duty); later installments depend on the degree course and ISEE, which must be authorized by 5 November 2026. The amount is not a complete annual tuition quote and is not valid as a 2027/28 estimate.

source_urls.title: 40 scholarships for first-year open-access Master's students 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The university offered 40 competitive gross awards of €2,000 for first-time enrollees in an open-access Master's in 2026/27. Eligibility included a Bachelor's result from 90/110 to 110/110 with honours and valid 2026 ISEE; the application period ran 15 July–17 November 2026. This general award was not guaranteed to any individual program and does not establish a 2027/28 call.

source_urls.title: ERDIS Marche scholarship call 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: ERDIS Marche opened its annual regional scholarship call for 2026/27 to students at Marche universities, including international students subject to the annual eligibility criteria. Online applications ran 14 July–28 August 2026; regional aid may include scholarship and student services under the call. This does not confirm 2027/28 rules or awards.

source_urls.title: ERDIS Marche scholarships and benefits
source_urls.evidence: ERDIS describes annual competitive aid for students enrolled at universities in Marche, with benefits including financial awards and possible meals/accommodation subject to eligibility and call conditions. It states that applications must be renewed each academic year.

source_urls.title: Useful contacts – International UnivPM
source_urls.evidence: The International Students' Admission Office page lists official contact channels, including the Economics-area phone number. General contact information only; the current call should be used to confirm 2027/28 procedures.

universities.name: Università degli Studi di Catania
universities.research_summary: Official sources show Data Science for Management was replaced by the Data Science MSc from 2022/23. Current course, English-program and admission evidence is for 2026/27; no 2027/28 program call, dates, tuition or scholarship call was identified, so the successor intake remains unverified.

source_urls.title: Data Science for Management – course page and replacement notice
source_urls.evidence: The official course page states that starting October 2022 (AY 2022/23), Data Science for Management would be replaced by the new Data Science course and enrollment for 2022/23 would be possible only in the new course.

source_urls.title: Data Science – 2026/27 degree page
source_urls.evidence: Lists Data Science for Academic Year 2026/27 as a two-year Master's Degree, class LM/DATA, taught in English, at Catania. This is prior-cycle evidence only and does not confirm the 2027/28 intake.

source_urls.title: Master's Degree programmes taught in English
source_urls.source_type: Official English-taught degree inventory and admissions page
source_urls.evidence: Lists ten English-taught Master's Degree courses including Data Science (LM-DATA), and states that the non-EU abroad call for the 2026/27 academic year is published. This page does not publish a 2027/28 call.

source_urls.title: Master's admissions call archive
source_urls.evidence: The archive page displays 2026/27 as its latest listed academic year (including the non-EU English-taught Master's call) and older calls; no 2027/28 Master's call is listed on the page checked on 9 November 2026. The page does not explicitly state that a 2027/28 call will not be published.

source_urls.title: First-year admission procedure for non-programmed two-year Master's courses, 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 procedure lists Data Science (LM-DATA) among the two-year Master's courses. It is a prior-cycle admissions source and cannot establish a 2027/28 intake or deadline.

source_urls.title: Public selection for admission of non-EU students abroad to English-taught Master's degrees, 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 selection lists Data Science (LM-DATA), for non-EU students living abroad applying to the first year of ten English-taught Master's degrees. It gives an application period of 10 February–17 March 2026, a €10 fee per course, and selection based on qualifications and, where applicable, an interview or test. These conditions apply to the prior cycle only; the table does not publish places for Data Science.

source_urls.title: Bachelor's Degrees – international qualification requirements
source_urls.evidence: Guidance reviewed for 2026/27 states general first-cycle entry requires a foreign secondary qualification after at least 12 years of schooling, suitable comparable-country access and any required country entrance exam; it describes B2 Italian or an accepted test for non-EU students and a 31 July 2026 Universitaly pre-enrolment deadline. These prior-cycle procedures are not carried forward to 2027/28.

source_urls.title: Manifesto degli studi and student contribution rules, 2026/27
source_urls.source_type: Official fee and student-regulations publication notice
source_urls.evidence: The latest fee-regulation notice located is for 2026/27. It reports contributions up to €2,150 for regular students meeting credit conditions and €2,350 for irregular students, with 2026/27 installment dates; none of these amounts or dates is treated as a 2027/28 fee schedule.

source_urls.title: University of Catania Scholarships 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 call offered five two-year scholarships of €2,000 per year for each of ten English-taught Master's degrees, including Data Science, with a 17 March 2026 deadline for non-EU applicants living abroad. This is prior-cycle information and no recurring 2027/28 award is inferred.

source_urls.title: International Students
source_urls.evidence: University page directs international students to degree-specific procedures and notes that rules and deadlines vary by program; no 2027/28 program facts are confirmed here.

universities.name: Università degli Studi di Milano
universities.research_summary: Four 2026/27 MSc leads now have course evidence. Computer Science is officially Italian/English, and Artificial Intelligence for Science and Technology is the same joint degree administered by Bicocca. Current calls, deadlines, fees and awards for 2027/28 remain unverified.

source_urls.title: Enrolment
source_urls.evidence: The University describes its 2026/27 admissions processes and says calls contain the applicable admission requirements, tests, places, rankings and enrollment procedures. It does not confirm any 2027/28 course call.

source_urls.title: Master's Degree Programmes – 2026/27 catalogue
source_urls.evidence: The official 2026/27 catalogue lists Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence for Science and Technology, Data Science for Economics and Health, and Bioinformatics for Computational Genomics. The individual pages establish distinct language and admissions classifications; this catalogue is not a 2027/28 intake notice.

source_urls.title: Computer Science – Master's degree profile
source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 course is an LM-18, two-year, 120-ECTS open-access Master's in Milan taught in Italian and English. L-31 graduates may apply; other degrees need at least 48 credits in INF/01 or ING-INF/05 and 12 credits in MAT/01–09; foreign qualifications are assessed for equivalence and preparation, with an interview possible. The study plan includes a 3-ECTS B2 English proficiency activity.

source_urls.title: Computer Science – admission notice AY 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 notice gives open-admission applications 22 January–30 October 2026, non-EU visa-applicant deadline 30 April, €30 application fee, enrolment 5 May 2026–15 January 2027, and apply.unimi.it for foreign qualifications. The listed deadlines and fee are prior-cycle only.

source_urls.title: Artificial Intelligence for Science and Technology – inter-university profile
source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 profile identifies the English-taught, two-year, 120-ECTS LM-91 joint degree run by Milano-Bicocca, the University of Milan, and Pavia. Bicocca is the administrative headquarters and handles admissions. Requirements include a Bachelor's degree, at least 30 CFU across listed computer science, engineering, mathematics, statistics or physics sectors, and English at B2 or higher.

source_urls.title: Data Science for Economics and Health – Master's profile
source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 profile identifies a two-year, 120-ECTS, English-taught LM-Data Master's in Milan, open access with entry-requirements examination. It links the annual admission procedure; it does not confirm a 2027/28 first-year intake.

source_urls.title: Data Science for Economics and Health – admission notice AY 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 notice requires a Bachelor's degree and at least 30 ECTS across computer science/mathematics, economics/statistics, and/or medical sciences, B2 English, and a written online assessment with possible interview. Applications ran 22 January–20 July 2026 (visa applicants by 30 April), cost €30, and used apply.unimi.it for foreign qualifications. These are prior-cycle conditions and dates.

source_urls.title: Bioinformatics for Computational Genomics – Master's profile
source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 course is a two-year, 120-ECTS, English-taught LM-8 R joint degree organized by the University of Milan and Politecnico di Milano, with first-year enrollment open, limited enrollment and an admission test. The profile lists 50 places plus 10 reserved for non-EU candidates applying for a visa.

source_urls.title: Bioinformatics for Computational Genomics – admission call AY 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 call accepts Biology/Life Science degrees with at least 30 CFU in biological areas and 18 CFU in genetics, molecular biology and biochemistry, or CS/engineering/physics/math/statistics degrees with at least 30 CFU in relevant quantitative areas including 6 CFU mathematics and 12 CFU in specified computing/statistics sectors. English B2 is required; interview/scoring rules differ by applicant group. Applications ran 24 March–26 June for most applicants and to 29 May for non-EU visa applicants; €30 fee; 50 places plus 10 visa-reserved. No 2027/28 call is established.

source_urls.title: International enrolment in degree programmes
source_urls.evidence: For 2026/27, non-EU applicants residing abroad needed a Universitaly pre-enrolment by 31 July; master's applicants with foreign qualifications completed documentation through apply.unimi.it, including translated/legalized degrees and CIMEA/DOV or accepted equivalents. This general guidance is prior-cycle only.

source_urls.title: Fees – current year AY 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: For 2026/27, the first instalment is a fixed €156. Tuition for students with income abroad varies by country group and course tuition area: Group A €200/€256, Group B €910/€1,164, Group C €3,204/€4,101.12 for Areas A/B; regional tax may remain due for Groups B/C. Students with eligible ISEE have a no-tax area up to €30,000 subject to merit. Amounts are prior-cycle and exact area/country eligibility must be checked.

source_urls.title: University scholarships AY 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: For 2026/27, the University offered 1,055 awards of €1,800 for students above the income threshold for regional DSU scholarships; applications ran 10 July–30 September 2026. Eligibility and merit rules are in the annual call. This is not a guaranteed award for any program or a 2027/28 offer.

source_urls.title: European Futures Scholarships AY 2026/27
source_urls.source_type: Official international scholarship page and call index
source_urls.evidence: The University announced 30 merit scholarships of €10,000 each for eligible EU students from universities outside Italy enrolling in Master's degrees in 2026/27; the scholarship page lists an application period 5 May–15 June 2026, later extended to 26 June. The programme is limited by applicant eligibility and is not a general award to all international applicants. It does not establish a 2027/28 call.

source_urls.title: Regional scholarships AY 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 Lombardy regional DSU competition was for enrolled University of Milan students meeting annual income and merit criteria; applications ran 10 July–30 September. Awards may include a cash scholarship, meal and full or partial fee exemption. International applicants with foreign income must follow the annual documentation rules. No 2027/28 call is confirmed.

source_urls.title: International scholarships – new Excellence award status
source_urls.evidence: The official award administration page states that no new allocations of the international Excellence Scholarships will be made from AY 2026/27. This does not affect separate 2026/27 European Futures or university/DSU competitions.

source_urls.title: Welcome Desk – International Admissions and Credentials Evaluation
source_urls.evidence: The University directs applicants who are not resident in Italy or hold foreign qualifications to the International Admissions and Credentials Evaluation Office through InformaStudenti. General contact route only.

universities.name: Università degli Studi dell'Aquila
universities.research_summary: Official 2026/27 Computer Science course, regulation and international selection sources are recorded as prior-cycle evidence. No 2027/28 first-year call, dates, tuition schedule or scholarship call was identified; the candidate remains pending.

source_urls.title: International students
source_urls.evidence: Official general international admissions guidance and route to annual calls; it does not establish a 2027/28 Computer Science call or deadline.

source_urls.title: Computer Science – official course sheet 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The official course sheet identifies Computer Science as a two-year LM-18 Master's in L'Aquila, taught in English, with open admission subject to assessment of personal competencies and skills. It is prior-cycle evidence and does not confirm a 2027/28 first-year intake.

source_urls.title: Computer Science LM-18 teaching regulations 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: Article 5 lists L-31/legacy class 26 or another qualifying degree with 48 CFU in INF-01/A or IINF-05/A and 12 CFU in the named mathematics sectors, and written/oral English at B2. The regulation describes the 2026/27 curriculum; required courses are in English while some optional courses may be in Italian. Prior-cycle criteria only.

source_urls.title: Selection call for international Master's applicants, cohort 2026
source_urls.evidence: The foreign-degree selection call for 2026/27 included Computer Science. It required a foreign Bachelor's degree of at least three years, B2 English (with an accepted certificate less than four years old or stated exemptions), and applied through PICA by 25 February 2026 at 13:00 Italy time with a €20 fee. Applicants could select up to two course rankings. The call is closed prior-cycle evidence; after selection, visa applicants were directed to Universitaly.

source_urls.title: International degree courses 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 official English international-degree catalogue lists Computer Science as a two-year second-cycle LM-18 course. The catalogue is prior-cycle evidence and does not confirm a 2027/28 first-year intake.

source_urls.title: Tuition and student contributions 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: For 2026/27 the fixed initial payment was €156 (regional tax plus stamp duty); the annual COA varied with household income/ISEE and other eligibility conditions. The page set the ISEE authorization deadline at 20 December 2026 and payment dates through January–May 2027. These are historical annual rules, not 2027/28 tuition values.

source_urls.title: Student contribution FAQ – international student provisions
source_urls.evidence: The FAQ explains that students with foreign family income may request equivalent ISEE; specified low-human-development-country students with a foreign entry qualification, refugees, Italian-government scholarship recipients, joint/multiple-degree students and ADSU scholarship recipients may qualify to pay the €156 fixed amount under the stated conditions. Recheck the annual fee guide for 2027/28 eligibility and values.

source_urls.title: Calls for international students 2026/27
source_urls.source_type: Official international scholarships and admissions calls index
source_urls.evidence: The University's 2026/27 index lists the foreign-degree English-Master's admission call, the ADSU residence call and 50 contributions toward travel and installation costs for foreign students intending to enroll in English-taught Master's programs. The published deadlines were 25 February, 27 July and 9 July 2026 respectively. No 2027/28 calls are established by this page.

source_urls.title: Travel and installation contributions for international Master's students 2026/27
source_urls.source_type: Official international student grant call index
source_urls.evidence: The University listed 50 competitive contributions to student travel and installation costs for foreign students intending to enroll in English-taught Master's programs in 2026/27, with a 9 July 2026 deadline. The index does not publish an amount in the reviewed summary and does not establish an award for new 2027/28 entrants.

source_urls.title: UNICORE 8.0 scholarship call 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The targeted call offered one scholarship for an eligible refugee student residing in a listed country to enter an English-taught second-cycle degree, including Computer Science, in 2026/27. It described €4,800 per year from the University and additional partner benefits, with renewal into 2027/28 subject to merit. This is not a general scholarship or a new 2027/28-entry award.

source_urls.title: ADSU L'Aquila scholarship call 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: ADSU published its annual 2026/27 competitive scholarship call for students at the University of L'Aquila and other local institutions. The application deadline was 31 August 2026. This is general regional student aid subject to the annual call and eligibility rules; it is not a guaranteed Computer Science award or a 2027/28 call.

source_urls.title: ADSU L'Aquila student residence call 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The regional agency's 2026/27 residence call awarded student beds through an online competition, with a 27 July 2026 deadline. The call is annual and does not establish a 2027/28 housing or scholarship offer.

source_urls.title: Computer Science international admissions ranking 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The University published the list of candidates eligible to enroll in the English-taught Computer Science Master's program for 2026/27. The list is an outcome for one call and does not provide a complete applicant denominator or an acceptance rate.

universities.name: Università degli Studi dell’Insubria
universities.research_summary: The official course profile and admissions guidance document Computer Science for 2026/27, including its English MSc profile, entry requirements and prior-cycle pre-enrolment route. No 2027/28 new-entry call, dates, fees or scholarship call were identified; the candidate remains pending.

source_urls.title: Enrolment of non-EU students residing abroad
source_urls.evidence: Page gives 2026/27 application and document deadlines and does not establish 2027/28 program-level dates.

source_urls.title: Informatica (Computer Science) – official course profile 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The current course profile lists Informatica (Computer Science) as a two-year Laurea Magistrale in Varese, English-taught and open access. The page links the 2026/27 course regulation and SUA-CdS and repeats the current course entry requirements. The profile does not confirm a 2027/28 first-year intake.

source_urls.title: Informatica MSc course regulation 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The official 2026/27 regulation identifies Informatica as an LM-18, two-year Laurea Magistrale based in Varese, with English teaching and open access. It is prior-cycle evidence and does not establish 2027/28 availability.

source_urls.title: Admission requirements – Informatica
source_urls.evidence: Applicants may hold an Italian L-31/26 or L-8/09 bachelor’s degree; other or foreign degrees can qualify with at least 60 CFU in INF-01/A and IINF-05/A combined and 18 CFU in the specified mathematics sectors. English at B2 or equivalent is required, and all applicants undergo an interview on fundamental computer science; a negative interview result bars access for that academic year. The page reflects the current/2026/27 requirements and is not a 2027/28 notice.

source_urls.title: Pre-enrolment for non-single-cycle Master's degrees, 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: For 2026/27, pre-enrolment to open-access MSc courses ran from 1 July to 30 October 2026 via Student Web Services/Esse3, using the 'Test di valutazione' application and supporting identity and qualification documents. The course secretariat evaluates the qualifications and contacts the applicant for an interview; eligible students then complete enrolment and pay through PagoPA. The next-cycle calendar is not stated.

source_urls.title: Enrolment for non-EU students resident abroad
source_urls.evidence: For 2026/27, applicants needing a study visa had to apply for pre-enrolment and preliminary assessment through Universitaly, with submissions accepted through 30 June 2026. University guidance describes foreign-qualification documentation and says applicants to English-taught courses are exempt from the University's Italian-language test. These are annual prior-cycle procedures, not 2027/28 deadlines.

source_urls.title: Student contribution regulation 2026/27
source_urls.source_type: Official annual tuition and contribution regulation
source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 regulation sets the registration payment at €146 initially, composed of €16 stamp duty and €130 regional tax, with possible regional-tax adjustment to €160 or €190 based on ISEE. For regular students in Area B (the area including Informatica), the university contribution is zero up to €28,000 ISEE and reaches €3,660 above €66,000. Students with foreign citizenship and family income/assets abroad may instead use a country-group flat contribution; for Area B's K=1.1 coefficient, the 2026/27 amounts are €220, €770 or €3,630 by group. Rules depend on eligibility and are historical only; no 2027/28 schedule was identified.

source_urls.title: Merit and excellence scholarships under the 2026/27 fee regulation
source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 contribution regulation lists university-wide merit awards for two-year MSc students: 15 first-year in-residence awards of €2,000, 7 first-year out-of-residence awards of €3,000, and 20 second-year awards of €750. Awards are competitive, subject to the regulation and its eligibility conditions, and do not guarantee an award to Computer Science applicants or confirm a 2027/28 call.

source_urls.title: Right-to-study benefits call 2026/27
source_urls.source_type: Official regional DSU scholarship and accommodation call
source_urls.evidence: The annual call offers competitive right-to-study benefits including scholarships/meal support and reduced-rate accommodation, subject to financial and merit criteria. In 2026/27 scholarship/meal applications ran 24 July–30 September 2026 and accommodation applications 24 July–24 August; foreign students could use ISEE Parificato procedures. No 2027/28 call is identified.

source_urls.title: Scholarships and right-to-study support
source_urls.evidence: The University describes regional-funded right-to-study scholarships as competitive and jointly dependent on merit, academic progression and income; amounts vary by income band and travel distance and are set in the annual call. A separate university merit-scholarship page links awards for BSc and single-cycle students; that page is not treated as a Computer Science MSc award source.

source_urls.title: Infostudenti – student information and contact service
source_urls.evidence: The course profile and university service directory link Infostudenti as the student information/contact pathway. No verified course-specific admissions email is published on the reviewed course profile; the contact pathway is provided instead of inferring an email address.

universities.name: Università di Bologna
universities.research_summary: A 2027/28 call is confirmed for the Erasmus Mundus CLE and the English Intelligent Embedded Systems 28DIGITAL track; the rest of the degree inventory remains under review.

source_urls.title: Application – Erasmus Mundus CLE
source_urls.evidence: Publishes AY 2027/28 application intakes from November 2026 to February 2027 and March to April 2027, with results in March and May. Exact day-level deadlines are not supplied on the reviewed page.

source_urls.title: Computer Science and Engineering – admissions and requirements
source_urls.evidence: Identifies the MSc and its Intelligent Embedded Systems curriculum as English-taught, with a Bologna-managed local track (15 places) and a 28Digital track (10 places) managed by 28Digital. The shared curricular entry requirements include a relevant first-cycle degree or specified 42 ECTS including at least 18 ECTS in computer science/engineering; B2 English is required for Intelligent Embedded Systems. The 28Digital track is open for 2027/28.

source_urls.title: Intelligent Embedded Systems – 28Digital track
source_urls.evidence: For a.y. 2027/28, the English Intelligent Embedded Systems 28Digital track has three application sessions: 30 Oct 2026–31 Jan 2027 for EU/EEA/CH and non-EU applicants; 1 Feb–18 Apr 2027 primarily for EU/EEA/CH and applicants not requiring a residence permit; and 19 Apr–31 May 2027 only for EU/EEA/CH and non-EU applicants not requiring a study visa. Admissions are managed directly by 28Digital. The 28Digital track combines a first-year entry university and a different-country second-year exit university, and grants a double degree plus a 28Digital certificate.

universities.name: Università di Camerino
universities.research_summary: The official 2026/27 English master's list and course profiles match four historic English MSc leads. Course-level requirements are recorded where published; Computer Science and Mathematics curricula and Chemistry naming show official-page discrepancies. 2027/28 first-year availability, admissions, fees and awards remain unconfirmed.

source_urls.title: International admissions FAQ
source_urls.evidence: Says all international students, EU and non-EU, are invited to pre-admission for curriculum evaluation; a positive result is followed by Universitaly pre-enrolment where relevant. Gives the Welcome Office contact and describes visa handling and annual ERDIS aid in general terms. Any timing on the page is not a 2027/28 deadline.

source_urls.title: Master’s degrees – international English course list
source_urls.evidence: Lists two-year, 120-credit master’s degrees and identifies Chemistry, Computer Science (4 curricula), Mathematics and Applications (2 curricula named Advanced Theoretical Mathematics and Applied Engineering Oriented Mathematics), and Physics as English-taught. The page does not specify an academic year, so it supports discovery and course identity only, not a 2027/28 first-year intake.

source_urls.title: Manifesto degli studi – academic offer and regulations 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The official study-manifesto page identifies the 2026/27 academic offer and regulations and links the annual manifesto, course offer and student-benefit documents. It is a prior-cycle source and does not establish 2027/28 new-entry availability.

source_urls.title: Computer Science – official degree profile
source_urls.evidence: Identifies Computer Science as an English-taught LM-18 Master’s in Camerino, two years/120 CFU and open access. The profile names four active curricula (AI, SDT, BIS and MTDC) but later says the course has five curricula; the separate international English master list also says four. This profile does not itself specify an academic year or confirm 2027/28 intake.

source_urls.title: Master’s Degree in Chemistry – official English degree profile
source_urls.evidence: Identifies a two-year, 120-credit LM-54 Master’s degree in Chemistry in Camerino, with training activities delivered in English. The international English master list also uses Chemistry, while the Italian School page and 2026/27 international package retain the title Chemistry and Advanced Chemical Methodologies; the official materials use both titles. This does not confirm 2027/28 intake.

source_urls.title: Chemistry and Advanced Chemical Methodologies – official course page
source_urls.evidence: The Italian School of Chemistry page identifies Chemistry and Advanced Chemical Methodologies as an LM-54, two-year, 120-CFU course in Camerino and says all educational activities are delivered in English. This differs from the shorter Chemistry title used on the English profile and international English master list; confirm the preferred displayed title in the 2027/28 offer.

source_urls.title: Mathematics and Applications – official degree profile
source_urls.evidence: Identifies Mathematics and Applications as an English-taught LM-40 Master’s in Camerino, two years/120 CFU and open access. It lists three curricula (Pure Mathematics, Mathematics for Industrial Engineering, Mathematics for Analytics and Finance) and says entry requires a Mathematics bachelor’s or another bachelor’s with at least 30 ECTS in Mathematics plus adequate Algebra, Analysis and Geometry; English B1 is required. The international master list instead says two curricula with different names. This does not confirm 2027/28 intake.

source_urls.title: Physics – official degree profile
source_urls.evidence: Identifies Physics as an English-taught LM-17 Master’s in Camerino, two years/120 CFU and open access. Entry requires a first-level degree or foreign equivalent with at least 70 CFU in Physics subject areas and 30 CFU in Mathematics and Informatics; English B1 is required. The profile is general/current and does not confirm a 2027/28 first-year intake.

source_urls.title: Pre-admissions 2026/27 – international applicants
source_urls.evidence: For 2026/27, the non-EU pre-admission call is closed and the listed deadline was 31 March 2026; EU/equivalent non-visa applicants are directed to welcome@unicam.it. International candidates register in the teaching portal, submit preliminary curriculum evaluation and pay a non-refundable €20 fee. For English courses Cambridge, IELTS or TOEFL documents are optional at pre-admission and MOI certificates are excluded by this page; a positive evaluation is not final enrolment and visa applicants must continue through Universitaly. No 2027/28 route or deadline is confirmed.

source_urls.title: Pre-admission procedure – official guide 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The guide describes registration, preliminary evaluation and document upload for 2026/27 BSc, MSc and one-tier MSc applicants; mandatory documents and completed €20 payment were required before committee evaluation. It is historical process evidence and does not establish a 2027/28 application route or deadline.

source_urls.title: Fees for foreign students
source_urls.evidence: The page describes income-based ISEE-U equalised assessment for specified foreign applicants, fixed annual fees of €200 for students from designated particularly poor/developing countries and €300 for non-OECD countries outside that list, with regional tax and stamp duty added. It also describes a €6,876 all-inclusive option. The page does not label these amounts with an academic year; do not treat them as 2027/28 fees.

source_urls.title: Lump-sum enrollment package for international MSc students 2026/27
source_urls.source_type: Official international tuition and accommodation offer
source_urls.evidence: For 2026/27, the University advertised five places per named two-year MSc, including Chemistry and Advanced Chemical Methodologies, Computer Science, Mathematics and Applications, and Physics. The package costs €6,876 per academic year and includes tuition, double-room accommodation October–July, two meals per day while the canteen is open, local bus, sports facilities and administrative support, payable in four instalments. Historical offer only; no 2027/28 package is confirmed.

source_urls.title: University tuition and student contributions 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The University fee page publishes 2026/27 contribution rules and installment details. Amounts depend on ISEE-U and other eligibility conditions; its all-inclusive domestic offer is not treated as an international flat rate. No 2027/28 fee schedule was identified.

source_urls.title: ERDIS Marche scholarship call service – 2026/27
source_urls.source_type: Official regional scholarship service and call page
source_urls.evidence: ERDIS identifies Italian and foreign students at Camerino and other Marche universities as eligible to apply subject to merit and financial criteria. The 2026/27 deadline was 28 August 2026; applications are annual and online, and awards may include cash, meals, accommodation and tuition/tax exemptions. No 2027/28 call is confirmed.

source_urls.title: WELCOMEINUNICAM scholarships for two-year Master’s students 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The University announced 30 WELCOMEINUNICAM awards of €1,500 each for first-time entrants with an Italian or foreign bachelor’s degree enrolling in year one of a two-year MSc in 2026/27. The application deadline was 18 February 2027 at 12:00 through the student portal. This is a prior-cycle notice, not a 2027/28 award commitment.

universities.name: Università degli Studi di Ferrara
universities.research_summary: The 2026/27 catalogue confirms the Physics MSc (LM-17), English delivery, interview-based requirements and prior-cycle non-EU process. Current-cycle intake, dates, application fee, tuition and awards remain unverified.

source_urls.title: Enrol in a post-graduate course
source_urls.evidence: General guidance for international applicants to postgraduate courses; no 2027/28 catalog or cycle-specific deadline is stated on this page.

source_urls.title: Degree catalogue 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The catalogue page identifies the 2026/27 offer and lists bachelor's and master's degrees, including the two-year, English-taught Physics MSc (LM-17). It is an annual prior-cycle catalogue and does not establish new-entry availability for 2027/28.

source_urls.title: Physics – course profile 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The official profile names Physics as a Laurea Magistrale in class LM-17, at Ferrara, with open access and English teaching for academic year 2026/27; it also notes a double-degree option. This confirms course identity in the prior-cycle catalogue only.

source_urls.title: Physics – degree overview
source_urls.evidence: The course page says the Physics master's is fully taught in English, awards 120 ECTS over two years, and is the natural follow-up to a bachelor's degree in Physics or a related area. It is general course information and does not confirm a 2027/28 intake.

source_urls.title: Physics – admission and enrolment guidance, 2026/27
source_urls.evidence: The course page identifies an extra-EU 2026/27 enrolment period of 12 January–30 April. Applicants need a Physics bachelor's degree, Italian L-30 or legacy class 25 degree, or a certified foreign bachelor's degree; the committee evaluates the academic record and Physics background through an interview that also checks English skills. The listed background includes calculus, geometry, algebra, chemistry, core classical and modern physics, experimental methods, electronics and computing. No 2027/28 course-specific dates or intake are established.

source_urls.title: Apply for a Master's degree – international procedure
source_urls.evidence: For the 2026/27 cycle, non-EU applicants abroad applying to Physics were directed to submit through apply.unife.it from 12 January to 30 April, pay a non-refundable €20 application fee, upload qualification documents and also submit through Universitaly. ER.GO scholarship/accommodation applications are normally announced in July and August. This page was last updated 4 June 2026 and does not establish the 2027/28 route, fee or dates.

source_urls.title: Applicants with foreign qualifications – applicant categories
source_urls.evidence: For extra-EU applicants resident abroad applying to English-taught Physics, the page specifies apply.unife.it registration from 12 January to 30 April and Universitaly pre-enrolment by 30 June. It also says course-specific reserved places are set annually and evaluation requires applications through both systems. The page was last updated 18 December 2025; these dates are recorded as the prior-cycle route only.

source_urls.title: Entrance visa request – international students
source_urls.evidence: Updated 25 May 2026. For the 2026/27 process, non-EU applicants abroad apply through Universitaly; admission/pre-enrolment does not guarantee a study visa. The page states an English certificate of at least B2 may be required by the relevant embassy/consulate when English is not the applicant's mother tongue, and students must complete enrolment in Ferrara within one month of visa issuance (31 January only for late-issued visas). It does not establish a 2027/28 visa procedure.

source_urls.title: University fees and contribution rules, 2026/27
source_urls.source_type: Official annual fees and contribution page
source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 contribution page uses ISEE or foreign-income documentation and study-year/credit rules. First-year students with ISEE up to €27,000 receive a full tuition-contribution exemption and pay €156 in stamp and regional tax; the listed contribution at ISEE above €60,000 or without ISEE is €2,092 for regular first-year students. These amounts depend on eligibility and are prior-cycle only, not a 2027/28 international flat fee.

source_urls.title: ISEE or foreign-income documentation for fees
source_urls.evidence: The University allows students with income abroad to request a fee reduction using the required foreign-income documentation instead of ISEE. The page says the 2026/27 deadline was 2 November 2026, with a €100 surcharge for documentation submitted from 3 November to 15 December 2026. Annual deadline and fee rules do not establish 2027/28 terms.

source_urls.title: ER.GO study-benefit competition call 2026/27
source_urls.source_type: Official regional scholarship and student-benefit call
source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 regional call includes students enrolling at the University of Ferrara in bachelor's and master's degrees. Foreign students are eligible subject to income, merit and documentation conditions; benefits can include a scholarship, accommodation and meals, and application/award terms are governed by the annual call. This is prior-cycle regional aid and does not confirm a 2027/28 award or deadline.

source_urls.title: International Mobility Office – contact information

source_urls.evidence: Lists international@unife.it as the contact for incoming international mobility and student-support activities. It is a general contact, not a 2027/28 admissions decision channel.

source_urls.title: Physics – teaching manager contact
source_urls.evidence: Names Anca Teodora Lazar as the Physics degree's didactic manager and gives manager.fisica@unife.it as the course contact. This is a course-information contact, not a 2027/28 intake confirmation.
