official_program_source_urls.title: Corsi di laurea magistrale – A.A. 2026/2027
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Annual inventory lists eleven distinct Engineering MSc degrees across two departments; no unique degree named only Engineering is identified. The list and linked admission calls concern 2026/27.

official_program_source_urls.title: Corsi di laurea – A.A. 2026/2027
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Bachelor inventory and admission links explicitly cover 2026/27. Includes Computer and Artificial Intelligence Engineering L-8 with restricted local access; BSc procedures are separate from the generic MSc lead.

official_program_source_urls.title: International Students – current central guidance
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Current page links 2026/27 course calls and a national circular valid for 2026/27 and 2027/28. Its own Universitaly deadline is explicitly 15 September 2026; university pre-enrollment approval does not guarantee a consular visa.

official_program_source_urls.title: How to apply – students with foreign qualifications 2026/27
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Prior-cycle guide requires at least 12 school years for bachelor entry and a relevant first-cycle degree for MSc entry. GOMP assessment uses degree/transcript and detailed syllabi, translation/authenticity evidence as applicable; visa applicants also use Universitaly, then original-document verification. The introduction retains an outdated 2025/26 national-reference line.

official_program_source_urls.title: International Students Office – contact details
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Current International Students Office supports foreign-qualification pre-enrollment, admission and enrollment. Relevant email is international.admissions@uniroma3.it; address Via Ostiense 133, Tower B, 00154 Rome. This supersedes the older orientation page's foreign-qualification email/address for current contact purposes.

official_program_source_urls.title: DiSCo – 2026/27 right-to-study competition announcement
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Regional provider's 10 June 2026 announcement covers students at Lazio institutions and scholarships, accommodation, meals and other benefits. Application first phase ran 10 June–22 July 2026 at noon; enrollment could be completed by 10 February 2027. This is the prior-cycle competition, not a 2027/28 award call.

official_program_source_urls.title: DiSCo – Bando Diritto allo Studio 2026/27
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Official indexed call extract states scholarship ISEE/ISEEUP ceiling 28,339.88 euros and ISPE/ISPEUP ceiling 61,608.48 euros; exceeding either excludes the applicant. Full PDF retrieval returned HTTP 403 in this review, so detailed awards and documentation were not exhaustively verified.

official_program_source_urls.title: Corsi in lingua straniera – Engineering department
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Department page dated 1 September 2026 describes Sustainable Coastal and Ocean Engineering and Aerospace Engineering MSc courses as offered in English; central Aerospace profile instead says Italian/English.

official_program_source_urls.title: Regolamento Tasse – DR 70/2026
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Current regulation applies from 2025/26 and was updated in January 2026. Contribution and exemptions depend on ISEE, course and career conditions; the foreign-income route uses ISEE Parificato through the agreed CAF. Its general continuing rules are not a dedicated 2027/28 annual fee schedule.

official_program_source_urls.title: Tasse e contributi universitari
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Page states 2026/27 regional tax of 140 euros plus 16-euro stamp duty, with a separate income/course-dependent annual university contribution. One to four installments depend on the fee band; first-year payment deadlines come from the admission call. The fixed 156 euros is not normal total tuition.

official_program_source_urls.title: Presentazione ISEE
official_program_source_urls.evidence: 2026/27 first-year students have 60 days from enrollment to present ISEE. Missing ISEE normally means the highest contribution bracket. Eligible foreign-income/nonresident households use the Personal CAF/CAF CISL process; even DiSCo winners with foreign income must submit the required declaration.

official_program_source_urls.title: National international-student procedures 2026/27 and 2027/28
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Circular has explicit biennial validity. For degree courses the 2027/28 national visa-application outer deadline is 31 October 2027; universities may set earlier dates. Visa pre-enrollment uses Universitaly. Non-Italian courses require certification of their teaching language rather than an Italian test; visa-stage non-native language evidence must cover four skills at least at B2. This does not confirm any Roma Tre course intake.

official_program_source_urls.title: UNICORE 8.0 – two refugee scholarships for 2026/27 entrants
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Closed refugee-only call admitted two 2026/27 MSc entrants; support extends to 2027/28 subject to renewal. Applications ran 2 March–17 April 2026 noon UTC+2. Benefits include fee exemption, housing and meals. Renewal needs 25 CFU by 10 August 2027. This is not a new 2027/28 entrant competition.

official_program_source_urls.evidence: English-taught degree applicants used MoveIN pre-selection. The 2026/27 cycle opened 22 December 2025; the non-EU visa-applicant deadline was 15 May 2026, the EU/equivalent deadline was 31 July 2026, and Universitaly pre-enrolment was due 30 June 2026. A candidate could submit up to two applications. Pre-selection was only one step and did not guarantee final admission. No 2027/28 first-year schedule is stated on the reviewed page.

official_program_source_urls.title: International Student Office admissions procedures 2026/27
official_program_source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 procedure distinguishes EU/equivalent candidates from non-EU applicants residing abroad. English-course applicants requiring a study visa needed the MoveIN pre-acceptance letter and Universitaly pre-enrolment by 30 June 2026; final admission still depended on the individual course call, qualification verification, visa, and completed enrollment. Foreign qualifications were reviewed for authenticity and comparability. Italian-taught programs required certified Italian B2 for non-EU applicants abroad who needed a visa.

official_program_source_urls.title: Artificial Intelligence for Science and Technology – admission procedure 2026/27
official_program_source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 procedure requires a Bachelor's degree or equivalent, at least 30 CFU overall in specified computer-science, mathematics, statistics or physics areas, B2 English, and a personal-preparation interview. Italian-qualification applications ran 2 March–1 September 2026 with a €30 fee; foreign-qualification applicants used DreamApply/apply.unimib. These are prior-cycle rules and dates.

official_program_source_urls.title: Artificial Intelligence for Science and Technology – Master's profile
official_program_source_urls.evidence: The current official title is Artificial Intelligence for Science and Technology, LM-91, two years, English, based jointly across Milano and Pavia and administered by Milano-Bicocca. The course profile links to its 2026/27 call for application.

official_program_source_urls.title: International Courses – programmes entirely taught in English
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Lists Artificial Intelligence, Artificial Intelligence for Science and Technology, Astrophysics and Space Physics, Data Science, Human-Centered Artificial Intelligence and International Economics among the University's programmes entirely taught in English. The page is not a 2027/28 first-year call.

official_program_source_urls.title: Bicocca International Scholarship Programme – call AY 2026/27
official_program_source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 call reserves eligibility for international students residing abroad with foreign qualifications. It lists Data Science, International Economics, Artificial Intelligence for Science and Technology, Astrophysics and Space Physics, and Human-Centered Artificial Intelligence among participating Master's courses. It assigns five competitive awards per listed course, each worth €10,000 gross per academic year plus a tuition-fee exemption; administrative and regional fees remain payable. The call's separate undergraduate entry uses the wording 'Artificial Science (LT)', so the BSc Artificial Intelligence lead is not matched to that award here.

official_program_source_urls.title: Student contribution fees AY 2026/27
official_program_source_urls.evidence: For 2026/27, the University expanded its ISEE no-tax area to €30,000 subject to merit criteria. The general student contribution is variable by ISEE and course area; non-Italian citizens with foreign entry qualifications and foreign residence follow a fixed country-of-residence and course-area tariff. No 2027/28 fee schedule was identified.

official_program_source_urls.title: Access for students with an international qualification
official_program_source_urls.evidence: For 2027/28, the university says foreign-qualification entry requirements will vary depending on the country where the qualification was obtained and directs applicants to apply.unimib.it and country-specific guidance. Its current instructions require foreign-qualification applicants to apply through that platform. This page does not give degree-program application dates or confirm the six candidate programs for 2027/28.

official_program_source_urls.title: Benefits for the right to university education – call AY 2026/27
official_program_source_urls.evidence: The University announced the 2026/27 DSU call for scholarships and student benefits; applications opened 7 July 2026 through the Online Help Desk, with deadlines varying by benefit in the call. Annual eligibility, award amounts and deadlines must be rechecked for 2027/28.

official_program_source_urls.title: Student contribution and fees FAQ 2026/27
official_program_source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 FAQ lists a €146 first installment (regional-tax advance plus stamp), later variable charges, ISEE-based no-tax eligibility up to €30,000 subject to merit, and an ISEE submission deadline of 13 November 2026. It is prior-cycle general guidance, not an individual international student's fee quote.

official_program_source_urls.title: Computer Engineering MSc – admission criteria
official_program_source_urls.evidence: degree: L-8 Information Engineering, L-31 Computer Science or equivalent foreign qualification; curricular_credits: {'basic_minimum_cfu': 36, 'characteristic_minimum_cfu': 42}; english: B2 certificate, eligible English-medium degree or degree-course English exam, or CLAT B2 test; assessment: Personal-readiness assessment; international documentation scoring requires at least 85/110; italian: Foreign applicants without B1 Italian certification may enroll but must add an Italian-language exam to their study plan. official_program_source_urls.title: UniGe degree course catalogue
official_program_source_urls.evidence: The catalogue links the ten reviewed BSc/MSc candidates to course profiles displaying Info 2026/2027. Separate Computer Engineering BSc records exist for Italian teaching in Genoa (11880) and English teaching in Imperia (12133). No named 2027/28 first-year offer is established by this catalogue.

official_program_source_urls.title: Computer Engineering MSc – personal readiness assessment
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Applicants submit degree/transcripts, CV and B2 English evidence, with accepted English-medium or degree-exam alternatives or CLAT testing. Foreign-applicant assessment uses documented preparation scoring with admission at 85/110; foreign candidates without B1 Italian may add an Italian-language exam to the study plan. This undated guidance does not establish the 2027/28 procedure.

official_program_source_urls.title: Computer Engineering MSc – course profile 2026/27
official_program_source_urls.evidence: The official profile displays 2026/2027: Computer Engineering, MSc, 2 years/120 ECTS, class LM-32, English, Genoa, In-person. It describes free access subject to the course's entry/initial or personal preparation checks. This verifies the previous-cycle listing only.

official_program_source_urls.title: ALiSEO scholarship and accommodation call 2026/27
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Annual competitive benefits require enrollment, merit and economic eligibility; ISEE/ISEEUP must not exceed €28,339 and ISPEU/ISPEUP €61,608. Awards vary by income band and on-site/commuting/off-site classification, with cash, meal and possible housing components. In band 1A an off-site housing applicant's €7,172 gross award includes services rather than all cash. Foreign-income applicants require the call's equivalent-ISEE documentation. No 2027/28 award is inferred.

official_program_source_urls.title: How tuition fees work – 2026/27
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Three installments: initial €136 consists of €16 stamp and €120 minimum regional tax, with any tax adjustment later. University contribution depends on ISEE-U, fee class, study group and full/part-time enrollment; the full-time table ranges from €0 to €3,300 plus fixed charges. 2026/27 deadlines: first installment 5 October for BSc or 30 November for open-access MSc, second 10 December 2026, third 23 June 2027. €136 is not total annual tuition.

official_program_source_urls.title: UniGeApply International Admissions
official_program_source_urls.evidence: 2027/28 non-EU visa preselection is expected mid-December 2026 through end-March 2027; exact dates await publication. €30 fee covers up to two assessment applications. English-taught programs do not require Italian.

official_program_source_urls.title: UniGeApply international admissions 2026/27
official_program_source_urls.evidence: For non-Italian qualifications, UniGeApply was the initial assessment route. Visa applicants: 26 November 2025–20 March 2026, €30 fixed for up to two requests; Computer Engineering BSc closed early on 8 March 2026. official_program_source_urls.evidence: UniGe announced the joint Master’s degree Conservation and Restoration Sciences (CORES), coordinated by UniGe with four European partner universities, with admissions planned to open in early 2027 and a planned start in academic year 2027/28. The Erasmus Mundus Joint Master proposal was still under evaluation, so formal approval, call terms and exact dates were not yet confirmed.

official_program_source_urls.title: Degree Programmes – 2026/27
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Official inventory is explicitly AY 2026-2027; Computer Engineering LM-32 is an Italian-language open-access Master. No 2027/28 course offer is established.

official_program_source_urls.title: Computer Engineering MSc admission call 2026/27
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Assessment deadline 14 December 2026; enrollment 8 July–22 December 2026. Academic requirements, foreign-degree assessment, 10 reserved non-EU abroad places, Italian language and ESSE3/Universitaly steps are specified. The call provides no acceptance-rate denominator or specific application fee.

official_program_source_urls.title: Computer Engineering MSc – course 20-362
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Course profile identifies a two-year, Italian-language, open-access LM-32 Master in Modena. President Francesco Guerra, francesco.guerra@unimore.it.

official_program_source_urls.title: Computer Engineering – department information
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Department describes Cloud and Cyber Security and Data Engineering and Analytics tracks since 2023/24. General entry description mentions degree score at least 85/110 or foreign score above three quarters; the annual course call controls admission.

official_program_source_urls.title: Student fee resolution – 14 May 2026
official_program_source_urls.evidence: 2026/27 fee resolution sets Computer Engineering MSc maximum annual fees including fixed items at €2,290 (€2,540 for the specified fuori-corso category). Fixed items total €159.67. ISEE/merit reductions and optional foreign-income country-ISEE flat tax are regulated separately.

official_program_source_urls.title: Foreign study qualification
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Foreign qualification guidance directs open-access MSc applicants to ESSE3 academic assessment and the individual annual call; visa applicants also pre-enrol through Universitaly. Bachelor admission requires a recognized school qualification after at least 12 years. Translation/legalization and DOV/CIMEA documentation apply as required.

official_program_source_urls.title: International Welcome Desk (Modena)
official_program_source_urls.evidence: International Welcome Desk: internationalwelcomedesk@unimore.it, telephone 059 2058171, Via San Geminiano 3, Modena.

official_program_source_urls.title: ER.GO 2026/27 study-benefit competition
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Regional annual competition covers UNIMORE students. Scholarship application: 23 June–24 August 2026 16:00. Cash/services depend on income, merit and residence classification. Example lowest income band: off-site €7,171.11, commuting €4,190.71, on-site €2,890.16, including any meal-service conversion; higher ISEE reduces amounts. Foreign financial documentation is required.

official_program_source_urls.title: ER.GO economic thresholds 2026/27
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Scholarship and housing economic thresholds: ISEE ≤€25,000 and ISPE ≤€50,000. Both indicators must qualify; other benefits have separate thresholds.

official_program_source_urls.title: Fees and benefits 2026/27
official_program_source_urls.evidence: First-year initial fixed payment is €159.67, with any variable contribution charged later. Normal payments are up to four installments; first-year open-access MSc first and second installments are due 22 December 2026, then 1 March and 30 April 2027.

official_program_source_urls.title: Flat Tax Non-EU International Students
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Optional country-based notional ISEE for non-EU students resident abroad with income and assets abroad. Applicants may instead submit translated/legalized financial documents. Links a 2026/27 country table and simulator; no 2027/28 rate is established.

official_program_source_urls.title: No Tax Area / ISEE reductions
official_program_source_urls.evidence: 2026/27 No Tax Area and reduced contributions depend on ISEE and, after the first year, merit. First-year Master applicants apply via ER.GO by 22 December 2026 at 16:00. The fixed €159.67 remains payable for qualifying exemptions.

official_program_source_urls.title: Top Student exemption 2026/27
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Conditional first-year fee exemption scheme requires top prior qualification marks; MSc applicants need 110/110. Outside Emilia-Romagna residents pay fixed €159.67 only; region residents pay €859.67 total. MSc application deadline 22 December 2026 at 16:00. Foreign-grade equivalence is not specified on this page.

official_program_source_urls.title: Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence – course profile
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Names the LM-18 MSc in Palermo and course contact cicsi@unipa.it. Lists B2 English and entry via L-31, L-35, L-8, L-41 or L-30 degrees, another Italian degree with 6 ECTS Mathematics/Physics and 12 ECTS Computing, or an equivalent foreign degree. The profile has no 2027/28 intake declaration.

official_program_source_urls.title: Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence – course presentation
official_program_source_urls.evidence: The course presentation explicitly identifies English as the official teaching language and English thesis writing. This is an undated programme description and cannot establish a new 2027/28 intake.

official_program_source_urls.title: Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence – new-enrolment study plan
official_program_source_urls.evidence: The new-enrolment study plan is explicitly labelled 2026/2027, with 2025/2026 in the archive. It does not publish a 2027/28 first-year plan.

official_program_source_urls.title: Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence – teaching regulation, 2025/26
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Regulation covers the 2025/26 cohort: LM-18, English, conventional teaching in Palermo. It repeats the course-profile academic routes and B2 English; candidates without L-31 must undergo a Mathematics/Computing interview with the coordinator or teachers. This regulation is not a 2026/27 or 2027/28 call.

official_program_source_urls.title: Giovanni Pilato – official teaching assignments
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Lists Information Retrieval and Natural Language Processing, 6 ECTS, under Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence in AY 2027/28. It is a teaching assignment and contains no new-entry admission, first-year cohort or application call.

official_program_source_urls.title: Before Applying – FAQ International Students
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Explicitly says exact 2027/28 admission dates have not yet been published; explains that requirements and selection procedures vary by program.

official_program_source_urls.title: Degree offer 2026/27
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Lists Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence, LM-18, Palermo, open access. The university resolution sets a general non-EU-abroad capacity of 30 for conventional open-access courses; the course row does not give a separate quota. This is a 2026/27 offer.

official_program_source_urls.title: EU and equivalent foreign-degree enrolment
official_program_source_urls.evidence: EU/equivalent applicants use the UniPa Student Portal. After the admission letter, the course coordinator conducts a personal-knowledge interview, including English assessment. Foreign qualifications require original legalised degree and DOV or accepted CIMEA/Diploma Supplement alternatives.

official_program_source_urls.title: International Master degrees – 2026/27
official_program_source_urls.evidence: The international catalogue is labelled enrolling in AY 2026/27 and lists Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence. The page describes two-year second-cycle courses with 120 credits.

official_program_source_urls.title: Extra-EU international enrolment – 2026/27
official_program_source_urls.evidence: For 2026/27 English MSc applications: first call 15 January–15 March; second 15 April–20 July 2026; Universitaly application by 23 August for candidates already applying in UniPa portal; personal-knowledge interviews through 30 November. Requires passport, photo, degree, transcript, language evidence and CV. English route uses UniPa portal assessment followed by Universitaly.

official_program_source_urls.title: International language requirements
official_program_source_urls.evidence: General guidance lists IELTS Academic 5.5, TOEFL iBT 72, PTE 46, Trinity ISE II–IV and recognised Cambridge/British Institutes qualifications. Its explicit English-certificate exemption is for programmes with a recognised English standardised admission test; it does not repeat the MOI alternative found on the 2026/27 Extra-EU page. No 2027/28 course-specific standard is established.

official_program_source_urls.title: ERSU Palermo scholarship and services call, 2026/27
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Annual 2026/27 benefit competition: applications 5 June–22 July 2026 at 14:00. Income limits ISEE €23,000 and ISPE €52,500. International applicants need equivalent ISEE and residence documentation, regularisable by 30 November 2026. Monetary amounts depend on ISEE and residence classification; meals/housing values are deducted when provided. For ISEE €11,500–€15,333.33, the off-site gross base is €7,171.11; with both services the cash portion is €4,271.11. Eligibility, merit and available funding apply.

official_program_source_urls.title: Student contribution regulation – linked PDF dated 2024/25
official_program_source_urls.evidence: The regulation's decree and text expressly state AY 2024/25. The current index labels this link as a 2025/26 regulation in force for 2026/27, creating a document-label mismatch. The PDF alone cannot confirm next-cycle exemptions.

official_program_source_urls.title: Student contribution regulation and archive
official_program_source_urls.evidence: The latest table is labelled 2026/27. The linked regulation is labelled 2025/26 in force for 2026/27, but its PDF title and text are 2024/25. This document-label discrepancy should be verified before treating its exemption rules as current. No 2027/28 table appears.

official_program_source_urls.title: Student contribution table, 2026/27
official_program_source_urls.evidence: The table expressly covers 2026/27 and shows €16 stamp + €140 regional tax. Scientific-area contribution is €370–€2,914 by ISEE before exemptions/reductions. It gives 40%/30%/30% instalments and second-instalment deadline 29 December 2026, whereas the university web fee guide says 31 December.

official_program_source_urls.title: Student fees and contributions
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Fees comprise stamp, regional tax and income/course-dependent contribution. General schedule is 40% on enrolment, 30% by 31 December 2026 and 30% by 28 February 2027; open-access MSc pays its first instalment when enrolling. The second instalment date conflicts with the 29 December date in the 2026/27 table.

official_program_source_urls.title: International tuition fees – 2026/27 framework
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Foreign-resident non-EU students may choose €211/€267/€378 flat charges by country grouping or income assessment through ISEE parificato. The income route has €156 fixed charges (€140 regional tax + €16 stamp) plus a variable contribution. The flat-charge text incorrectly calls all €156 regional tax; the separate contribution table confirms €140 + €16. Financial-document references are for 2024 income and 2026 household/property circumstances.

official_program_source_urls.title: International Students Enrolment
official_program_source_urls.evidence: International qualification holders use the dedicated international admission routes. Credential Evaluation Office email is internationalstudents@unipa.it. Visa pre-enrolment does not guarantee a visa.

official_program_source_urls.title: First international Master call, 2026/27

official_program_source_urls.title: ADiSU Umbria scholarship and services call 2026/27
official_program_source_urls.evidence: The regional 2026/27 call was open to students enrolled or intending to enroll at Umbria institutions, subject to income, enrollment and merit requirements. The published application deadline was 2 September 2026 at noon. ISEE and ISPE limits were €28,339.88 and €61,608.48. Applicants with foreign household income/assets had to submit supporting foreign-income documentation by separate deadlines (2 September or 30 October 2026), following legalization/translation rules. These regional benefits are competitive and are not a program-specific guaranteed award; no 2027/28 call is confirmed.

official_program_source_urls.title: Becoming a UniPG student – international admissions
official_program_source_urls.evidence: For 2026/27 non-EU applicants residing abroad, the general PICA pre-evaluation window was 29 May–7 June 2026 noon; applicants supplied passport, qualifying-credential documents, language evidence if available and CV, and could apply to only one course. Engineering Management had a dedicated PICA procedure through 21 August 2026; visa applicants to both its BSc and MSc needed an accepted B2 certificate (MOI and other certificates were rejected), and BSc applicants had to provide CEnT-S, TOLC-I or SAT. Positive PICA evaluation was required before Universitaly visa pre-enrolment. The page gives international office contact details. These dates and steps are 2026/27 only and do not establish a 2027/28 call.

official_program_source_urls.title: ADiSU Umbria 2026/27 scholarship call – official PDF
official_program_source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 call publishes cash amounts by ISEE band and student status plus meal/accommodation values. In the lowest-income band, maximum standard totals include €8,246.78 for an off-site student with paid lodging (cash plus two daily meals), €8,246.78 for an off-site student in an ADiSU bed (cash, bed and meals), €4,819.32 for a commuter (cash plus one daily meal), and €3,623.68 for an in-town student (cash plus one daily meal). Award amounts reduce by income band and depend on eligibility, ranking, service allocation and documentation. Annex 4 lists Engineering Management BSc course L0615 (L-8/L-9) and MSc course M0622 (LM-31) among STEM courses eligible for a 20% cash uplift for women; this uplift is subject to the call's other rules and is not a guaranteed award. This is 2026/27 evidence only.

official_program_source_urls.title: Tuition Fees and scholarships – 2026/27 guidance
official_program_source_urls.evidence: The page, last updated 6 October 2026, says exact 2026/27 fees are governed by the University Regulation and gives a usual annual range of €150–€2,200 depending on family income and merit. Applicants whose family income/assets are abroad may use a four-bracket country-based flat contribution or opt for ISEEU Parificato; low-human-development-country and protection-status rules also apply. It does not publish 2027/28 fees.

official_program_source_urls.title: Computer Science NF225 course regulation, cohort 2026/27
official_program_source_urls.evidence: The course's regulation index labels this PDF NF225 cohort 2026/27. It establishes LM-18, two years/120 CFU, five curricula, L-31/L-8 entry or at least 45 CFU in INFO-01/A and IINF-05/A for other classes, individual foreign-curriculum assessment, and readiness assessment. The L-31/L-8 test exemption requires at least 85/110. Its 2026/27 IoT curriculum table marks technical teaching Engl. The English-language examination's B2 learning target is not a universal B2 admission-certificate requirement.

official_program_source_urls.title: Computer Science enrolment: foreign applicants
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Applications for 2026/27 are now closed. Relevant Bachelor's preparation and at least 45 computing ECTS are assessed individually. Non-EU applications start on Universitaly; emailed dossiers are not assessed. Positive documentary assessment leads to a compulsory remote C++/Java/database-query quiz and interview. Two interview no-shows cause rejection. Applicants without B2 Italian enter the English IoT curriculum. English evidence may be in CV/academic records; an officially English-taught previous degree avoids further certification under this guidance, while consulates may require a certificate. Contact: international_incoming@cs.unisa.it.

official_program_source_urls.title: Enrolment course inventory 2026/27
official_program_source_urls.evidence: The page explicitly welcomes applicants to 2026/27. Computer Science/Informatica NF225 is an LM-18 Master's with Italian and English teaching; the L-31 Bachelor's is Italian. Course-specific enrolment links control requirements. This does not confirm a 2027/28 first-year offer.

official_program_source_urls.title: Computer Science: English Internet of Things curriculum
official_program_source_urls.evidence: The course describes five specializations and explicitly says Internet of Things is fully English and lasts two years. This undated presentation is corroborated by the named 2026/27 regulation and is not evidence of a 2027/28 intake.

official_program_source_urls.title: International teaching: degrees in English 2026/27
official_program_source_urls.evidence: The explicit 2026/27 inventory lists Computer Science NF225 as English/Italian, rather than identifying every curriculum as English. It lists other BSc, MSc, postgraduate master and PhD categories separately. No new 2027/28 course offer is established.

official_program_source_urls.title: ADISURC regional scholarship call 2026/27, English PDF
official_program_source_urls.evidence: University of Salerno students are eligible subject to enrolment, merit and financial requirements. ISEE ceiling is 25,500 euros and numeric ISPE ceiling 54,000 euros. Foreign-household ISEEUP must reach ADISURC by 31 March 2027. Base awards at ISEE up to 17,000 euros are 7,171.11 off-site, 4,190.71 commuter and 2,890.16 on-site; service deductions, higher-income reductions and eligible uplifts apply. First years normally need 20 credits by 10 August 2027 for full preservation, or by 30 November for half. Benefits are conditional and do not establish 2027/28 awards.

official_program_source_urls.title: Computer Science teaching facilities
official_program_source_urls.evidence: The course facilities page locates main classrooms and laboratories in F2/F3/F4 on the Fisciano campus; the shared inventory also includes Avellino facilities. It does not establish a 2027/28 campus change or promise remote attendance.

official_program_source_urls.title: Computer Science student and teaching offices
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Computer Science career administration: carrierestudenti.di@unisa.it. Teaching office: didattica.di@unisa.it. Both link the student Help Desk.

official_program_source_urls.title: Computer Science: enrolment and assessment timing
official_program_source_urls.evidence: The course page states Master's enrolment 15 July 2026–1 March 2027, ESSE3 registration, assessment in September/February and academic contact gvitiello@unisa.it. One curricular bullet incorrectly names the separate Cloud/Security degree; the NF225 regulation and English Computer Science admission page provide independent course-specific requirements. The general enrolment period is not the earlier non-EU Universitaly deadline.

official_program_source_urls.title: Universitaly pre-enrolment deadline: 30 September 2026
official_program_source_urls.evidence: The Computer Science department notice published 25 September 2026 states Universitaly pre-enrolment is accepted until 30 September 2026 and later applications will not be assessed. This deadline belongs to the closed 2026/27 intake.

official_program_source_urls.title: Student contribution regulation 2026/27
official_program_source_urls.evidence: The official PDF was fetched directly with HTTP 200 and parsed after the page's relative link resolved incorrectly in the web tool. Fees comprise income/progress-dependent COA, stamp and regional tax. Regional tax is 130/151/173 euros; foreign-resident households ordinarily use 151 euros. Non-EU non-residents normally use COA band III or band I for listed low-human-development countries, unless eligible ISEE or hardship rules apply. Stamp is 16 euros; foreign-qualification first-year third instalment, if due, is 53 euros. General access-test contribution is 15 euros subject to course exceptions, not a verified IoT prescreening fee. First-year open-access MSc enrolment is due 1 March 2027.

official_program_source_urls.title: Tuition and contributions 2026/27
official_program_source_urls.evidence: The fee page explicitly covers 2026/27 and links the annual fee regulation. The no-tax-area COA exemption has an ISEE ceiling of 30,000 euros and statutory progress/enrolment conditions; payment is through pagoPA in ESSE3. This is not a 2027/28 fee publication.

official_program_source_urls.title: UNISA Scholarship call 2026/27
official_program_source_urls.evidence: The call is for 48 non-EU students resident abroad with suitable foreign degrees. Annual value is 8,000 euros: 1,800 cash after enrolment/payment plus room/board valued at 6,200 for 12 months from 1 October 2026. Required dossier includes CV, B2 language evidence, degree/transcripts, syllabi, two references and the incompatibility declaration. Renewal requires 27 credits by 15 September 2027; its 2027/28 reference is the second year of the 2026/27 intake. It is incompatible with MAECI and duplicate room/board benefits; ADISURC cash-only benefits may be sought under the rules. Tuition and regional payment obligations remain.

official_program_source_urls.title: Non-EU citizens abroad: qualification and visa route
official_program_source_urls.evidence: University guidance uses Universitaly for non-EU applicants abroad, university qualification evaluation and subsequent consular visa processing. It mentions November 2026 and also retains an older March 2025 opening reference, so it is not a 2027/28 schedule. Bachelor's qualifications normally follow 12 years of schooling. Italian-taught degree applicants require B2 Italian or the indicated test unless exempt. Recognition documentation may include ENIC-NARIC, an official foreign institution's evidence or a Declaration of Value.

official_program_source_urls.title: ADISURC scholarship and accommodation competition 2026/27
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Published 24 July 2026: the regional competition closed 10 September 2026 at 12:00. Apply through the ADISURC student reserved area; foreign applicants can obtain registration credentials. The notice links the call and CAF/ISEE-equivalent documentation. The competition is not a 2027/28 award.

official_program_source_urls.title: Internationalisation office contacts
official_program_source_urls.evidence: General international enquiries: erasmus@unisa.it. UNISA Scholarship: unisascholarship@unisa.it. The page also lists distinct Erasmus incoming/outgoing contacts and a helpdesk for enrolled students; these are separate from the Computer Science assessment committee's address.

official_program_source_urls.title: Universitaly national international-student procedures 2026/27 and 2027/28
official_program_source_urls.evidence: The national page expressly covers 2026/27 and 2027/28. The 2027/28 outer deadline for degree-study visa applications is 31 October 2027, with institutions allowed to set earlier course deadlines. Universitaly is the official free visa-pre-enrolment portal; admission/validation does not guarantee a visa. This does not publish a Salerno course application window or a new first-year offer.

official_program_source_urls.evidence: Describes the UniTrento 28DIGITAL offer as two-year, 120-ECTS double-degree master’s study with technical majors in Information Engineering (Cloud and Network Infrastructures and HPC; Intelligent Chips and Systems), Computer Science (Cyber Security, Data Science, Fintech, Human-Computer Interaction & Design with extended reality), and Artificial Intelligence Systems (Artificial Intelligence with Affective Computing). For the 2027/28 intake it lists three application periods: 31 Oct–11 Feb open to EU/EEA/CH and non-EU applicants; 11 Feb–15 Apr open to EU/EEA/CH and non-EU Italian residents, with visa timing limitations; and 15 Apr–1 Jun open to EU/EEA/CH and non-EU Italian residents. The page says not all trajectories may be available in period two, central selection is handled by 28DIGITAL, and consortium scholarships are first-come-first-served. UniTrento's additional double-degree scholarships are for second-year entrants who receive no other 28DIGITAL grant; their call is indicatively published in August.

official_program_source_urls.title: Intelligent Chips and Systems (ICS) – 28DIGITAL Master School
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Describes the two-year master's, relevant bachelor fields, minimum 40 ECTS in ICT and 20 ECTS in mathematics, and the 2027 first-period deadline of 31 January. UniTrento lists itself as an exit point for this track.

official_program_source_urls.title: 28DIGITAL Master School – tuition fees and scholarships
official_program_source_urls.source_type: Official joint-master fees and funding page
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Lists €75 non-refundable application fee per application, €250 non-refundable registration deposit credited to first-semester tuition, and tuition of €6,000 per academic year for EU/EEA citizens or €18,000 for non-EU/EEA citizens. General merit-based awards include full or half tuition waivers; additional excellence scholarships with living allowance are restricted to EU/EEA and associated-country citizens in selected programs. Period 1, 2 and 3 tuition-payment expected deadlines are 31 May, 30 June and 19 July 2027, respectively.

official_program_source_urls.title: Physics MSc: how to apply 2026/27
official_program_source_urls.evidence: The page is explicitly 2026/27. L-30/equivalent degree or a Bachelor with at least 15 CFU in MAT/05, MAT/03, INF/01 and 30 in FIS/01-04; English B2. Assessment applications 20 April 2026–29 January 2027; enrolment 20 April 2026–31 March 2027. ESSE3 documents include ID, qualification/exams self-declaration, Excel questionnaire and language evidence. Foreign qualifications additionally follow international procedures.

official_program_source_urls.title: Physics MSc official profile
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Physics is a two-year, 120-CFU LM-17 R MSc in Trieste, mainly classroom teaching, non-competitive admission with preparation assessment, and languages English and Italian. It is not an English-only degree. Reviewed with the explicitly 2026/27 admission page; no 2027/28 new-entry offer is verified.

official_program_source_urls.title: ARDiS unified call updated 14 October 2026
official_program_source_urls.evidence: 2026/27 scholarship deadline 17 September 2026 at 13:00 CEST; first-year housing deadline 27 August. Standard gross scholarship amounts: off-site EUR7,171.11, commuter EUR4,190.71, on-site EUR2,890.16; income thresholds reduce or increase amounts, with separate STEM-women provisions. Housing charges are deducted from scholarship for assigned accommodation, so gross figures are not all cash. First-years need the call's 20-CFU merit condition to retain full benefits. Foreign-income documentation and incompatible-award rules apply.

official_program_source_urls.title: Fee notice 2026/27
official_program_source_urls.evidence: The 2026/27 notice sets first-year initial instalment EUR250 (16 stamp, 120 initial regional tax, 114 tuition). Abroad residents meeting progress/duration requirements pay EUR800 tuition plus EUR160 regional tax and EUR16 stamp; failure adds 20% to tuition (EUR960). Italy-resident qualifying ISEE up to EUR30,000 gives zero tuition; above EUR75,000/no ISEE tuition is EUR2,900, or EUR3,195 without progress/duration eligibility. Timely ISEE is required. These are annual conditional rates, not 2027/28 fees.

official_program_source_urls.title: Physics MSc bodies and representatives
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Physics teaching secretariat: didattica.df@units.it. The course coordinator is Luigi Rigon. This general contact page does not establish next-cycle admission conditions.

official_program_source_urls.title: UniTS published visa quota table: updated 16 January 2026
official_program_source_urls.evidence: The quota table, last updated 16 January 2026, lists DSAI MSc 25 places and Physics MSc 10 including 2 Marco Polo places. The visible table does not state an academic year. Record only dated published-table context; do not relabel these figures as 2027/28 quotas or derive an acceptance rate.

official_program_source_urls.title: International students: required documents
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Updated 24 July 2025. Bachelor entry normally requires a qualifying diploma after at least 12 school years. MSc entry requires Bachelor/equivalent, transcript or EU Diploma Supplement, and official course descriptions. Translate non-Italian/non-English documents; legalization/apostille rules have stated country exceptions. UniTS says a DOV is not needed; CIMEA comparability may be requested in special cases. Follow individual assessment instructions for originals and language proof.

official_program_source_urls.title: UniTS pre-enrolment for visa applicants
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Non-EU residents abroad needing a visa must check available quotas, obtain positive assessment on ApplyNow, pre-enrol through Universitaly, complete the course's enrolment/payment requirements and upload the residence-permit application receipt after arrival. Contact international.students@amm.units.it. Admission does not guarantee a visa. Undated annual process guidance is not a 2027/28 course offer.

official_program_source_urls.title: Degree seekers: 2026/27 assessment rounds and application fee
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Last updated 2 October 2026. Foreign-qualification assessment for 2026/27 used apply.units.it: 15 December 2025–15 January 2026; 15 February–30 April 2026; EU/equivalent-only round until 2 October 2026. Fee EUR40 for up to three programmes. No 2027/28 university assessment calendar or fee was identified.

official_program_source_urls.title: ARDiS regional university benefits 2026/27
official_program_source_urls.evidence: 2026/27 regional benefit applications opened 15 July 2026 at 10:00; deadlines are 13:00 Italy time by benefit. University enrolment, merit and economic requirements apply together; ISEE ceiling EUR28,339.88 and ISPE ceiling EUR61,608.48. Foreign-household cases need ISEE parificato through affiliated CAF. Trieste contact info.trieste@ardis.fvg.it. No 2027/28 competition is established.

official_program_source_urls.title: University fees 2026/27
official_program_source_urls.evidence: The university page's 2026/27 framework has income/residence-dependent tuition, stamp duty and regional tax. Italy residents use timely ISEE Universita; residents abroad use flat reduced fees. MSc first-window instalments: 19 December 2026, 31 March and 28 May 2027; second-window: 31 March, 28 May and 15 June 2027, subject to course-specific first-enrolment deadlines. Payment is through PagoPA/ESSE3. ARDiS exemptions are applied after official eligibility lists. Fee-office contact tasse.studenti@amm.units.it.

official_program_source_urls.title: Ministerial international-student procedures 2026/27 and 2027/28
official_program_source_urls.source_type: Official ministerial procedure PDF hosted by university
official_program_source_urls.evidence: Ministerial memorandum valid for both 2026/27 and 2027/28: visa pre-enrolment uses Universitaly; the national last date to lodge a 2027/28 degree-study visa application is 31 October 2027, while universities may set earlier dates. A type-D entrant must apply for a residence permit within eight working days. This is a national framework, not a UniTS course application window or intake confirmation; Italian original prevails.

Curricular eligibility is an L-31 or L-8 degree (or former classes 26 or 9), or at least 24 CFU in relevant computer-science and mathematics subjects. A committee checks preparation and English at approximately B2; an interview or test may be required, except the page exempts graduates with at least 90/110. sources.title: Admission of international students – How to apply
sources.evidence: First application call for most programs opens 15 September 2026 and closes 15 November 2026; bachelor's entry normally requires 12 years of schooling; master's applicants need a relevant bachelor’s degree and program-specific requirements; English-taught degrees use apply.unipd.it.

sources.title: International students – 2027/28 applications (DiSSGeA)
sources.evidence: Lists History (Bachelor’s), Classical Languages and Literatures and Ancient History, Historical Sciences, Landscape Studies, Religious Studies, Local Development and Mobility Studies, and gives calls 15 Sep–15 Nov 2026, 1 Dec 2026–1 Mar 2027, and 1 Apr–1 Jun 2027 for EU and non-EU residents in Italy only.

sources.title: Deadlines – Admission to Laurea Magistrale with foreign qualification
sources.evidence: For September 2027 MSc entry, the page gives general 2027/28 windows of 1 Oct–1 Dec 2026 (early bird), 12–28 Jan 2027 and 1–18 Mar 2027 for EEA and certain non-EEA residents in Italy. Architecture/Design has its own table with a 1 Oct 2026–28 Jan 2027 general call and the same additional March call. A separate Engineering subsection labelled 2026/27 nevertheless describes the September 2027 intake and gives 12 Jan–25 Feb 2027, creating a cycle/date discrepancy that must be resolved by study area. Fees are €50 early bird or €150 standard, and candidates may apply to at most two programmes.

sources.title: Engineering BSc enrolment – 2027/28
sources.evidence: Publishes the 2027/28 Engineering BSc enrolment calendar: first phase 3 May–10 June 2027 (restricted eligibility and excludes English-taught programmes); preference deadlines for later phases are 17 June, 22 July and 26 August 2027, followed by rankings and enrolment deadlines. The page covers enrolment timing, not the pending cycle-specific Engineering call or total tuition amount. Dates are CEST.

sources.title: Documents required by the Admissions Office – English certification
sources.evidence: Gives 2027/28 English certificate scores for MSc applicants: TOEFL iBT at least 78 for tests through 20 Jan 2026 and at least 4.5 from 21 Jan 2026; TOEIC at least 785 Listening/Reading and 310 Speaking/Writing; IELTS at least 6; specified Cambridge, Trinity, Pearson and LanguageCert scores. Applicants whose bachelor’s was taught in English for at least three years may be exempt if their university certifies at least 75% of courses were in English.

sources.title: Merit Based Call for Applications – A.Y. 2027–2028
sources.evidence: Offers 10 Platinum (€10,000 gross), 18 Gold (€8,000 gross), 16 Piacenza Gold (€5,000 gross), 10 Piacenza Bronze (€2,500 gross), and 10 Silver awards (tuition waiver at Cremona, Lecco, Mantova and Piacenza); all include a tuition waiver for the award year. Eligible applicants must be international first-year MSc applicants to English-taught programs for 2027/28 and must have paid the admission application fee during 1 Oct–1 Dec 2026. Scholarship forms are accepted 1 Oct–15 Dec 2026 at noon Italian time. Awards are competitive and subject to admission and acceptance conditions.

sources.title: Engineering BSc admissions – 2027/28 call publication status
sources.evidence: For first-year Engineering BSc programs in 2027/28, the page says the admission call will be published shortly. It describes the required admission test and non-Italian qualification documentation but does not yet provide the complete 2027/28 call rules, full seat inventory, or all deadlines.

sources.title: CEnT-S – admission to Engineering BSc 2027/28

sources.evidence: For Engineering BSc entry in 2027/28, the page describes the English-language CEnT-S test (55 questions/110 minutes overall; Polimi uses Mathematics, reasoning on texts/data and Physics, 35 questions/70 minutes) and score-recording deadlines. For final-year or already graduated applicants taking a test from 1 Sep 2026 through 3 Jun 2027, the recording deadline is 3 Jun 2027 at 11:59 a.m. A separate 3 Jun deadline applies to the specified 2025/26 penultimate-year cohort that missed the prior recording deadline.

sources.title: Tuition fees – current published fee schedule

sources.title: HySET applications open for the 2027–2029 edition

Selection is scored on academic achievements, background relevance, references/video, and experience. The current page states a 2027–29 call is open.

sources.title: HySET programme structure and awarded degrees

sources.title: Preliminary evaluation of international qualifications
sources.evidence: States that applications for international qualifications seeking 2027/28 bachelor’s or master’s admission start in December 2026; exact calls and dates are to be published later.

sources.title: Buddhism and Asian Religions – programme and 2027/28 admission
sources.evidence: States that the MSc activates in 2027/28; level MSc, LM-64, Venice, English, two years/120 credits and open admission. The admission page says detailed 2027/28 procedures and deadlines will be updated in March 2027; the enrolment page requires B2 English and adequate preparation.

sources.title: Financial aid for high-achieving international students
sources.evidence: For 2027/28 lists 8 bachelor scholarships of €10,000/year for three years and 20 master’s scholarships of €10,000/year for two years. Ranking factors include CGPA at least 85%, motivational video, reference letters and language evidence; the complete call with exact deadlines is expected in late fall. The page lists International Office contact +39 041 234 7575 and prospective.students@unive.it.

sources.title: International programmes – English-taught degree list (2026/27)
sources.evidence: The official page groups English-taught bachelor's and master's programmes for 2026/27, including Computer Science - Data Science, Computer Science and Information Technology, Data Analytics for Business and Society, Economics, Finance and Sustainability, International Management, Comparative International Relations, Digital Management, Economics and Business, Hospitality Innovation and e-Tourism, and Philosophy, International and Economic Studies. This is the latest displayed course list, not a 2027/28 new-entry catalogue.

sources.title: Bachelor's and Master's degrees – course catalogue (2026/27)
sources.evidence: The official catalogue labels its course lists a.y. 2026/27 and includes course codes and languages. It lists Computer Science and Information Technology (CM90) as an English MSc and Informatica (CTR3) as a BSc with Italian and English language entries; Digital Management appears in the bachelor's list, not as a separate master's degree. Hospitality Innovation and e-Tourism (CTR9) appears in the bachelor's list. This does not confirm first-year availability for 2027/28.

sources.title: Annual tuition fees – international degree programmes (2026/27 entry guide)
sources.evidence: For 2026/27 entry, the guide lists annual fees by group: Italy/EU €2,352 BSc and €2,599 MSc; non-EU OECD €2,100 and €2,300; developing-country group €700 at both levels; all other countries €1,300 at both levels. It lists exceptions including Digital Management (€8,811) and Hospitality Innovation and e-Tourism (€7,025). These are prior-cycle guide figures, may interact with fee-reduction rules, and are not 2027/28 amounts.

sources.title: Regional right-to-study scholarship (2026/27)
sources.evidence: The 2026/27 page describes the Veneto regional grant administered by Ca' Foscari, a combination of cash and services, income eligibility below ISEE €26,306.25 and ISPE €43,125.94, and a general application deadline of 30 September 2026 at 12:30. The related ISEE-information page gives a later 18 December 2026 ISEE-equivalent submission deadline for first-year master's students. These are prior-cycle conditions; no 2027/28 regional call is confirmed here.

sources.title: Welcome Unit – international degree-seeker contact
sources.evidence: Identifies welcome@unive.it as the contact for degree-seeking and prospective international students and evaluation of international qualifications; the page provides appointment-based support in Italian and English.

sources.title: Digital Management – Bachelor's programme profile
sources.evidence: The profile identifies Digital Management as a three-year English BSc, L-18 R, 180 ECTS, Roncade, with limited admission. The page is the current programme profile and does not confirm a 2027/28 first-year intake.

sources.title: Economics and Business – Bachelor's programme profile
sources.evidence: The profile identifies Economics and Business as a three-year English BSc, L-33 R, 180 ECTS, Venice, with limited admission. The page does not confirm a 2027/28 first-year intake.

sources.title: Data Analytics for Business and Society – Master's programme profile
sources.evidence: The profile identifies a two-year English MSc, LM-91 R, 120 ECTS, Venice, open admission and a double/joint-degree option. It does not confirm a 2027/28 first-year intake.

sources.title: Economics, Finance and Sustainability – Master's programme profile
sources.evidence: The profile identifies a two-year English MSc, LM-56 R, 120 ECTS, Venice, open admission and a double/joint-degree option. It does not confirm a 2027/28 first-year intake.

sources.title: International Management – Master's programme profile
sources.evidence: The profile identifies a two-year English MSc, LM-77 R, 120 ECTS, Venice, limited admission and a double/joint-degree option. It does not confirm a 2027/28 first-year intake.

sources.title: Comparative International Relations – Master's programme profile
sources.evidence: The profile identifies a two-year MSc, LM-52 R, 120 ECTS, Venice, open admission, a double/joint-degree option and Italian/English teaching. The previous tracker’s English-only label is incomplete. It does not confirm a 2027/28 first-year intake.

sources.title: Computer Science – Bachelor's programme profile
sources.evidence: The profile identifies a three-year BSc, L-31 R, 180 ECTS, Mestre, open admission, with Italian/English language entries and three curricula; only the Data Science curriculum is taught in English. It does not confirm a 2027/28 first-year intake.

sources.title: Computer Science and Information Technology – Master's programme profile
sources.evidence: The profile identifies a two-year English MSc, LM-18, 120 ECTS, Mestre and open admission. It does not confirm a 2027/28 first-year intake.

sources.title: Hospitality Innovation and e-Tourism – Bachelor's programme profile
sources.evidence: The profile identifies Hospitality Innovation and e-Tourism as a three-year English BSc, L-15 R, 180 ECTS, Venice/Mestre, limited admission. The prior tracker classified it as an MSc; the latest official profile lists the BSc. It does not confirm a 2027/28 first-year intake.

sources.title: Philosophy, International and Economic Studies – Bachelor's programme profile
sources.evidence: The profile identifies a three-year English BSc, L-5 R, 180 ECTS, Venice and limited admission. It does not confirm a 2027/28 first-year intake.

sources.title: Digital Management – 2026/27 admission and enrolment
sources.evidence: The 2026/27 procedure is limited admission with TOLC-E, spring and summer rounds, mathematics assessment, B2 English, and international-qualification procedures. These requirements and rounds are prior-cycle evidence, not 2027/28 terms.

sources.title: Economics and Business – 2026/27 admission and enrolment
sources.evidence: The 2026/27 procedure is limited admission with TOLC-E, spring and summer rounds, mathematics assessment, mandatory B2 English by enrolment, and international-qualification procedures. These requirements and rounds are prior-cycle evidence, not 2027/28 terms.

sources.title: Data Analytics for Business and Society – 2026/27 admission and enrolment
sources.evidence: The 2026/27 page describes open admission, a three-year bachelor's qualification, at least 60 CFU in relevant business/economics/statistical-mathematics subjects (including minimum 12 CFU in economics/business and 12 in statistical mathematics), CV assessment and potential interview, and B2 English. These are prior-cycle requirements.

sources.title: Computer Science – 2026/27 admission and enrolment
sources.evidence: The 2026/27 page says Computer Science has open admission and only the Data Science curriculum is taught in English. TOLC-I is recommended; scores below 20/40 or no test lead to a mathematics-logic OFA, and the English curriculum requires B2. These are prior-cycle terms.

sources.title: Computer Science and Information Technology – 2026/27 admission and enrolment
sources.evidence: The page gives prior-cycle MSc conditions: at least 48 CFU in listed computer-science, mathematics, physics and statistics subject areas; personal preparation assessed through the CV and potentially an interview, with stated degree/85-of-110 exemption criteria; and B2 English. These are not confirmed for 2027/28.

sources.title: Admission A.Y. 2027-28 – Mechatronics Engineering
sources.evidence: MSc Mechatronics Engineering, two years/120 credits, taught in English; lists non-EU visa applicant windows 9–27 Nov 2026, 11–25 Jan 2027, 8–22 Feb 2027 and resident window 5 Jul–6 Sep 2027; €30 application fee, 60 non-EU-abroad seats plus 4 Marco Polo places, B2 English, curricular requirements and document list.

sources.title: Aims and scopes – Mechatronics Engineering
sources.evidence: States the program is taught entirely in English; the current cycle-specific admission page separately confirms 2027/28 availability.

sources.title: Enrollment (a.y. 2027/28) – Software: Science and Technology
sources.evidence: Program page specifies open admission for the 2027/28 MSc, bachelor’s qualification, country-specific grade threshold, 24 ECTS in CS/Computer Engineering and 24 ECTS in Mathematics/Physics/Statistics, B2 English evidence and possible interview.

sources.title: Course presentation – Software: Science and Technology
sources.evidence: States the MSc is entirely delivered in English and has two-year duration/120 CFU.

sources.title: Notice for International Students – AY 2027/2028, MSc Chemical Engineering
sources.evidence: States international pre-evaluation opens 10 January 2027; Universitaly opens from February/March 2027; exact dates and deadlines to follow.

sources.title: Master’s Degree in Chemical Engineering
sources.evidence: Identifies the MSc in Chemical Engineering (LM-22), Napoli campus, and Italian/English language; English curricula include Product Engineering and Sustainable Engineering.

sources.title: Application – Erasmus Mundus CLE
sources.evidence: Publishes AY 2027/28 application intakes from November 2026 to February 2027 and March to April 2027, with results in March and May. Exact day-level deadlines are not supplied on the reviewed page.

sources.title: Computer Science and Engineering – admissions and requirements
sources.evidence: Identifies the MSc and its Intelligent Embedded Systems curriculum as English-taught, with a Bologna-managed local track (15 places) and a 28Digital track (10 places) managed by 28Digital. The shared curricular entry requirements include a relevant first-cycle degree or specified 42 ECTS including at least 18 ECTS in computer science/engineering; B2 English is required for Intelligent Embedded Systems. The 28Digital track is open for 2027/28.

sources.title: Intelligent Embedded Systems – 28Digital track
sources.evidence: For a.y. 2027/28, the English Intelligent Embedded Systems 28Digital track has three application sessions: 30 Oct 2026–31 Jan 2027 for EU/EEA/CH and non-EU applicants; 1 Feb–18 Apr 2027 primarily for EU/EEA/CH and applicants not requiring a residence permit; and 19 Apr–31 May 2027 only for EU/EEA/CH and non-EU applicants not requiring a study visa. Admissions are managed directly by 28Digital. The 28Digital track combines a first-year entry university and a different-country second-year exit university, and grants a double degree plus a 28Digital certificate.

sources.title: International Students Admissions – Information Portal
sources.evidence: States the next 2027/28 international admissions intake opens in November 2026; detailed deadlines are not yet published on the reviewed page.

sources.title: Admission Calendar – 2027/28 status
sources.evidence: Explicitly says 2027/28 dates and deadlines have not yet been finalized. The calendar is organized by degree program and applicant category; the page does not yet supply Applied Mathematics dates or confirm its new-entry intake.

sources.title: Applied Mathematics – 2026/27 degree profile
sources.evidence: Lists Applied Mathematics as a 2026/27 second-cycle degree in Siena, 2 years/120 credits, taught in English, with open access. It is a prior-cycle listing and not a 2027/28 new-entry notice.

sources.title: Applied Mathematics – program overview
sources.evidence: Program page describes the English-taught MSc, LM-40, two-year duration, 120 credits and Mathematical Methodologies and Mathematical Models curricula. It does not name the 2027/28 entry cycle.

sources.title: Applied Mathematics – how to apply
sources.evidence: Gives a general route for applicants with a non-Italian degree via apply.unisi.it, lists documents including CV and transcript, and describes degree-background assessment. It says applications can usually be submitted January–May and contains an admission-test note dating from 2017/18; neither is treated as a current 2027/28 deadline or requirement without a new call.

sources.title: Siena International Excellence Scholarships – 2026/27 call
sources.evidence: For 2026/27, offers five €6,000 gross annual scholarships for one year, renewable for a second year, to international students with non-Italian citizenship and qualifications earned outside Italy. Area D has two awards for two different courses among seven listed English-taught master’s, including Applied Mathematics; the page does not allocate one award specifically to this program. Application deadline was 26 May 2026.

sources.title: Admissions for a.y. 2027-2028 – Let’s keep in touch!
sources.evidence: Asks international applicants interested in AY 2027/28 to register interest and states that admissions procedures will be communicated once available.

sources.title: Data Science for Management – Department of Economics and Management guide 2026/27
sources.evidence: The Department guide lists Data Science for Management as a second-cycle degree, two years, LM Data Science class, based in Parma, taught entirely in English, open access with verification of requirements and non-mandatory attendance. Its listed first- and second-year plan totals 120 ECTS. These 2026/27 details do not confirm a 2027/28 new-entry intake.

sources.title: Data Science for Management – 2025 admission regulations
sources.evidence: The 2025-version regulations for LM-DATA require a suitable three-year degree or recognized foreign equivalent, curriculum requirements, individual preparation assessment and English at least B1. Italian graduates with L-18/L-33 or equivalent meet the stated degree-class route; other classes need at least 30 CFU in named economics/business/statistics/mathematics/computing sectors with sub-minima of 9 CFU economics, 6 business, 9 quantitative or computing and 6 statistics. The document lists English evidence routes including IELTS 5.5, TOEFL iBT 60, Cambridge First/Business Vantage, Trinity ISE II or specified TOEIC subscores, and says individual preparation is checked by interview/test. Foreign qualifications are assessed for equivalence. This is a prior-version regulation, not verified 2026/27 or 2027/28 admission guidance.

sources.title: Call 26/27 – non-EU future students
sources.evidence: For non-EU applicants requiring a study visa, the university says English-taught Master's calls were available and admission opened 15 January 2026. The page directs applicants to degree-specific procedures and does not give Data Science for Management's own deadline or establish 2027/28 dates.

sources.title: Tuition and university contributions – 2026/27
sources.evidence: The 2026/27 fee page lists Data Science for Management and places it in the humanities-social area. The annual charge consists of a €140 regional tax, €16 virtual stamp and a personalized university contribution based on merit, enrollment seniority, disciplinary area and ISEE. The course-specific contribution is not a single fixed amount; this is prior-cycle information and not a 2027/28 quote.

sources.title: Fees, scholarships and benefits for international students
sources.evidence: The university's international-student fees guidance for the 2026/27 cycle states a €156 first instalment (regional tax and stamp duty) and an approximate €0–€2,000 personalized annual tuition contribution depending on financial circumstances and study area. The amount is not a fixed Data Science for Management quote and is not a 2027/28 estimate.

sources.title: ER.GO scholarship and other benefits for international students
sources.evidence: The university identifies ER.GO as Emilia-Romagna's higher-education benefits agency. International students may apply for competitive regional scholarships, accommodation and other benefits; applications for the annual call begin when it is published, with household financial documents uploaded through the ER.GO dossier. Amounts, eligibility and deadlines are defined by each call, so no program-specific award or 2027/28 award is implied.

sources.title: Study in Parma – LATAM Scholarships 2026/27
sources.evidence: The 2026/27 call offers five competitive awards of €8,000 gross per year for up to two years plus a tuition exemption to eligible Latin American applicants, but requires B2 Italian and admission to an Italian-taught Master's programme. Data Science for Management is taught in English, so this specific call does not apply to it.

sources.title: Before Applying – FAQ International Students
sources.evidence: Explicitly says exact 2027/28 admission dates have not yet been published; explains that requirements and selection procedures vary by program.

sources.title: Admissions to first-level degree courses
sources.evidence: The official page says 2027/28 admission call instructions for first-level degrees will be published in February 2027.

sources.title: Calls for application, regulations and ranking lists – Bachelor's
sources.evidence: Official page says 2027/28 bachelor calls are being finalized and will be published soon; the call page says Polito joins CISIA for 2027/28.

sources.title: Admission test – Bachelor's programmes, 2027/28
sources.evidence: For 2027/28, confirms Polito will use CISIA-administered tests and accept only in-person TOLC@UNI and CEnT@UNI tests at Polito or another participating university; remote TOLC@CASA and CEnT@CASA tests are not accepted. The official selection call is still forthcoming.

sources.title: Access for students with an international qualification
sources.evidence: For 2027/28, the university says foreign-qualification entry requirements will vary depending on the country where the qualification was obtained and directs applicants to apply.unimib.it and country-specific guidance. Its current instructions require foreign-qualification applicants to apply through that platform. This page does not give degree-program application dates or confirm the six candidate programs for 2027/28.

sources.title: International Courses – programmes entirely taught in English
sources.evidence: Lists Artificial Intelligence, Artificial Intelligence for Science and Technology, Astrophysics and Space Physics, Data Science, Human-Centered Artificial Intelligence and International Economics among the University's programmes entirely taught in English. The page is not a 2027/28 first-year call.

sources.title: Sciences – Master's degree programmes
sources.evidence: The official catalogue lists Artificial Intelligence for Science and Technology, Astrophysics and Space Physics, and Data Science as Master's degrees taught in English with open access subject to entry-requirement examination. It does not publish a 2027/28 intake notice.

sources.title: Artificial Intelligence – inter-university Bachelor's degree
sources.evidence: The Bachelor's in Artificial Intelligence is an English-taught inter-university L-31 degree with administrative headquarters at Pavia and classes across Pavia, Milano Statale and Milano-Bicocca. The profile states three years, limited access and that admission is managed by the University of Pavia.

sources.title: Artificial Intelligence – admission call 2026/27
sources.evidence: The University of Pavia administers the 2026/27 call for the English L-31 Bachelor's in Artificial Intelligence, offered with Milano-Bicocca and Milano Statale. The call lists 130 EU/equivalent or Italy-resident places, 45 non-EU-abroad places and 5 Marco Polo places; selection uses an admission test (CEnT-S or eligible prior English TOLC-I for specified categories, SAT for non-EU applicants abroad). These are prior-cycle quotas and rules.

sources.title: Artificial Intelligence – 2026/27 admission FAQ
sources.evidence: Pavia's FAQ gives 2026/27 registration windows of 9–25 June and 5–22 October 2026, with the second ranking on 10 November and enrollment through 16 November. It lists the relevant CEnT-S, English TOLC-I and SAT score thresholds by applicant category. These are prior-cycle dates and thresholds only.

sources.title: Artificial Intelligence for Science and Technology – Master's profile
sources.evidence: The current official title is Artificial Intelligence for Science and Technology, LM-91, two years, English, based jointly across Milano and Pavia and administered by Milano-Bicocca. The course profile links to its 2026/27 call for application.

sources.title: Artificial Intelligence for Science and Technology – admission procedure 2026/27
sources.evidence: The 2026/27 procedure requires a Bachelor's degree or equivalent, at least 30 CFU overall in specified computer-science, mathematics, statistics or physics areas, B2 English, and a personal-preparation interview. Italian-qualification applications ran 2 March–1 September 2026 with a €30 fee; foreign-qualification applicants used DreamApply/apply.unimib. These are prior-cycle rules and dates.

sources.title: Astrophysics and Space Physics – Master's profile
sources.evidence: The 2026/27 profile identifies a two-year, English-taught LM-58 Master's in Milan with open access subject to entry-requirement examination and links the 2026/27 call.

sources.title: Astrophysics and Space Physics – admission procedure 2026/27
sources.evidence: The 2026/27 call requires a suitable Bachelor's degree. An L-30 degree satisfies curricular entry; other degree classes require at least 18 CFU in mathematics and 18 CFU in physics. Personal preparation is assessed by interview; Physics/Astrophysics/Astronomy L-30 graduates with at least 90/110 are exempt. B2 English is required. Italian-qualification applications ran 13 April–19 June and 22 June–11 September 2026 with a €30 fee; foreign-qualification applicants use apply.unimib.it. These are prior-cycle rules and dates.

sources.title: Data Science – Master's profile
sources.evidence: The 2026/27 profile identifies a two-year, 120-ECTS English-taught LM Data Master's in Milan with open access subject to entry-requirement examination; it links the 2026/27 application procedure.

sources.title: Data Science – admission procedure 2026/27
sources.evidence: The 2026/27 call requires a Bachelor's degree, at least 30 CFU overall across informatics, computer engineering, statistics, mathematics and physics, B2 English and a personal-preparation interview. Italian-qualification applications ran 1 April–27 May and 29 May–1 September 2026 with a €30 fee. Foreign-qualification applicants applied through apply.unimib.it. These are prior-cycle rules and dates.

sources.title: International Economics – Master's profile
sources.evidence: The 2026/27 profile identifies a two-year, English-taught LM-56 R Master's in Milan with open access subject to entry-requirement examination and links its current-year admission calls.

sources.title: International Economics – admission procedure 2026/27
sources.evidence: The 2026/27 call requires a Bachelor's qualification and B2 English. The standard-degree route specifies L-18/L-33 or legacy L-17/L-28 with at least 110/110; candidates outside that route may be assessed on economics/business, quantitative methods and legal principles, with interview possible. Foreign-qualification candidates use DreamApply. Applications ran 1 April–7 September 2026; these are prior-cycle criteria and dates. No application fee was stated in the reviewed call.

sources.title: Human-Centered Artificial Intelligence – inter-university Master's profile
sources.evidence: The 2026/27 profile identifies a two-year, English-taught LM-55 inter-university Master's across Milano and Pavia, jointly organized by Milano-Bicocca, Pavia and Milano Statale. The University of Milan is the administrative headquarters and manages admission.

sources.title: Human-Centered Artificial Intelligence – application AY 2026/27
sources.evidence: The University of Milan managed 2026/27 HCAI admission. Applications ran 22 January–30 October 2026 and enrolment 5 May 2026–15 January 2027; non-EU visa applicants had to apply by 30 April 2026. The next-cycle dates are not established by this page.

sources.title: Bicocca International Scholarship Programme – call AY 2026/27
sources.evidence: The 2026/27 call reserves eligibility for international students residing abroad with foreign qualifications. It lists Data Science, International Economics, Artificial Intelligence for Science and Technology, Astrophysics and Space Physics, and Human-Centered Artificial Intelligence among participating Master's courses. It assigns five competitive awards per listed course, each worth €10,000 gross per academic year plus a tuition-fee exemption; administrative and regional fees remain payable. The call's separate undergraduate entry uses the wording 'Artificial Science (LT)', so the BSc Artificial Intelligence lead is not matched to that award here.

sources.title: Student contribution fees AY 2026/27
sources.evidence: For 2026/27, the University expanded its ISEE no-tax area to €30,000 subject to merit criteria. The general student contribution is variable by ISEE and course area; non-Italian citizens with foreign entry qualifications and foreign residence follow a fixed country-of-residence and course-area tariff. No 2027/28 fee schedule was identified.

sources.title: Student contribution and fees FAQ 2026/27
sources.evidence: The 2026/27 FAQ lists a €146 first installment (regional-tax advance plus stamp), later variable charges, ISEE-based no-tax eligibility up to €30,000 subject to merit, and an ISEE submission deadline of 13 November 2026. It is prior-cycle general guidance, not an individual international student's fee quote.

sources.title: Benefits for the right to university education – call AY 2026/27
sources.evidence: The University announced the 2026/27 DSU call for scholarships and student benefits; applications opened 7 July 2026 through the Online Help Desk, with deadlines varying by benefit in the call. Annual eligibility, award amounts and deadlines must be rechecked for 2027/28.

sources.title: Contacts – International degree-seeking students
sources.evidence: The International Admissions and Welcome Office manages international admission and enrollment procedures and directs applicants holding foreign qualifications to apply.unimib.it. Contact information is general and does not establish a 2027/28 course deadline.

sources.title: Becoming a UniPG student – international admissions
sources.evidence: For 2026/27 non-EU applicants residing abroad, the general PICA pre-evaluation window was 29 May–7 June 2026 noon; applicants supplied passport, qualifying-credential documents, language evidence if available and CV, and could apply to only one course. Engineering Management had a dedicated PICA procedure through 21 August 2026; visa applicants to both its BSc and MSc needed an accepted B2 certificate (MOI and other certificates were rejected), and BSc applicants had to provide CEnT-S, TOLC-I or SAT. Positive PICA evaluation was required before Universitaly visa pre-enrolment. The page gives international office contact details. These dates and steps are 2026/27 only and do not establish a 2027/28 call.

sources.title: International admissions FAQ
